title: Manager, Data Analytics - AI Enablement
description:
Position Summary...

The Manager, Data Analytics supports the development and implementation of data-driven strategies to optimize business performance. Responsibilities include pricing, promotional strategies, market analysis, web analytics, and reporting, fostering cross-functional collaboration to drive insights and decision-making.

What you'll do...

We are seeking an analytics leader to drive the development of our enterprise semantic models and AI-enabled analytics capabilities. This role will design, build, and maintain scalable semantic models to standardize business metrics across all Business Units, ensuring consistent and trusted data consumption.

In parallel, this individual will lead the application of Generative AI within our BI ecosystem—enabling AI-assisted dashboard creation, insight generation, and advanced analytical workflows. They will also design and build AI agents to automate repetitive analytics tasks and streamline processes within the Analytics & Insights organization.

This role requires deep technical expertise in semantic modeling, BI architecture, and applied AI solutions, along with strong business partnership skills. The ideal candidate is highly detail-oriented, comfortable building production-grade solutions, and excited to modernize how insights are defined, generated, and operationalized across the enterprise.

The Manager may identify gaps in reporting infrastructure, implement best practices, and introduce automation. Training and supporting other departments in self-service reporting and maintaining vendor relationships for analytics tools are also key responsibilities.

Cross-functional collaboration is essential, working with all business units to ensure alignment and integration of analytics initiatives. The Manager may present data and recommendations to senior leadership and stakeholders, ensuring data-driven decision-making across the organization.

Qualifications

  • Semantic data modeling expertise using Google LookML or equivalent
  • BI architecture and dashboard development using GenAI tools
  • Applied Generative AI within analytics workflows
  • AI agent design and workflow automation
  • SQL and data transformation proficiency
  • Cross-functional stakeholder collaboration


Leadership Expectations:

Respect the Individual:

Demonstrates and encourages respect for all; builds a high-performing team; seeks, and embraces differences in people, cultures, ideas and experiences; creates a workplace and experiences where all associates feel seen, supported and connected through culture of belonging so associates thrive and perform; drives a positive associate and customer experience for all; identifies, attracts, and retains the best team members.

Creates a discipline and focus around developing talent, through feedback, coaching, mentoring, and developmental opportunities; promotes an environment allowing everyone to bring their best selves to work; empowers associates and partners to act in the best interest of the customer and company; and regularly recognizes others’ contributions and accomplishments.

Builds strong and trusting relationships with team members and business partners; works collaboratively and cross-functionally to achieve objectives; and communicates and listens attentively, with energy and positivity to motivate, influence, and inspire commitment and action.

Acts with Integrity:

Maintains and promotes the highest standards of integrity, ethics and compliance; models the Walmart values and leads by example to foster our culture; supports Walmart’s goal of becoming a regenerative company by making a positive impact for associates, customers, and the world around us (e.g., creating a sense of belonging, eliminating waste, participating in local giving).

Follows the law, our code of conduct and company policies, and sets expectations for others to do the same; promotes an environment where associates feel comfortable sharing concerns and reinforces our culture of non-retaliation; listens to concerns raised by associates. takes action and encourages others to do the same; holds self and others accountable for achieving results in a way that is consistent with our values.

Acts as an altruistic servant leader and is consistently humble, self-aware, honest, and transparent.

Serve our Customers:

Delivers expected business results while putting the customer first and consistently applying an omni-merchant mindset and acts with an Every Day Low Cost mindset to drive value and Every Day Low Prices for customers.

Adopts a holistic perspective that considers data, analytics, customer insights, and different parts of the business when making plans and shaping the team’s strategy.

Strive for Excellence:

Consistently raises the bar and seeks to improve; demonstrates curiosity and a growth mindset; seeks feedback, asks thoughtful questions, fosters an environment that supports learning, innovation, and learning from mistakes, and intelligent risk-taking; and exhibits resilience in the face of setbacks.

Seeks and implements continuous improvements and encourages the team to leverage new digital tools and ways of working.

Qualifications:

  • Semantic data modeling expertise using Google LookML or equivalent

  • BI architecture and dashboard development using GenAI tools

  • Applied Generative AI within analytics workflows

  • AI agent design and workflow automation

  • SQL and data transformation proficiency

  • Cross-functional stakeholder collaboration

title: Manager, Portfolio Management
description:
Position Summary...

This role manages a portfolio of licensees in Walmart stores, sources new licensees, and maximizes licensee revenue by maintaining alignment to the licensee strategy, negotiating agreements, overseeing projects, and collaborating with internal and external stakeholders.

What you'll do...

The role involves managing a portfolio of licensees in Walmart stores by sourcing new licensees and negotiating renewals and expansions to maximize licensee revenue. This also includes acting as a point of escalation for unresolved facilities maintenance issues. Strategically developing the licensee pipeline through industry networking, and securing necessary approvals are also key responsibilities.

This role coordinates and oversees licensee life cycle activities by building and maintaining relationships with key stakeholders. It supports plans and initiatives to meet business and customer needs, sets and communicates goals, measures progress, and addresses improvement opportunities. The role also includes analyzing data to identify licensee opportunities and vacancy reduction options, evaluating the financial impact of projects, and making business recommendations based on data analysis.

Licensee portfolio management support includes facilitating licensee agreement approvals, ensuring compliance with laws and mitigation strategies, and providing input into budget forecasts for the licensee portfolio.

This role implements strategies to maximize licensee revenue by collaborating with cross-functional teams and promoting licensee interests to various stakeholders. Responsibilities include generating revenue through negotiations and partnerships, facilitating construction drawing approval and launch, and developing approval processes for projects. The role also involves sourcing new licensees, managing licensee life cycles, and collaborating with various departments on integrating solutions into the store network.

Leadership Expectations:

Respect the Individual:

Demonstrates and encourages respect for others; drives a positive associate and customer experience for all; embraces differences in people, cultures, ideas, and experiences; supports workplaces where associated feel seen and connected through a culture of belonging, so all associates thrive and perform; contributes to an environment allowing everyone to bring their best selves to work.

Demonstrates engagement and commitment to the team, developing others through feedback, coaching, mentoring, and developmental opportunities; and recognizes others’ contributions and accomplishments.

Builds strong and trusting relationships with team members and business partners; works collaboratively to achieve objectives; communicates with impact and listens attentively to a range of audiences; and demonstrates energy and positivity for own work.

Acts with Integrity:

Maintains and promotes the highest standards of integrity, ethics and compliance; models the Walmart values and leads by example to foster our culture; supports Walmart’s goal of becoming a regenerative company by making a positive impact for associates, customers, and the world around us (e.g., creating a sense of belonging, eliminating waste, participating in local giving).

Follows the law, our code of conduct and company policies, and encourages others to do the same; supports an environment where associates feel comfortable sharing concerns; reinforces our culture of non-retaliation; listens to concerns raised by associates and takes action; acts with accountability for achieving results in a way that is consistent with our values.

Is consistently humble, self-aware, honest, and transparent.

Serve our Customers:

Delivers results while putting the customer first and applying an omni-merchant mindset and acts with an Every Day Low Cost mindset to drive value and Every Day Low Prices for customers.

Adopts a broad perspective that considers data, analytics, customer insights, and different parts of the business when making plans.

Strive for Excellence:

Consistently raises the bar and seeks to improve; demonstrates curiosity and a growth mindset; seeks feedback, asks thoughtful questions; supports innovation and intelligent risk-taking; and exhibits resilience in the face of setbacks.

Implements and supports continuous improvements and willingly embraces new digital tools and ways of working.

The pay range for this position is $91,900.00 - $126,390.00. Pay will be determined based on relevant experience.

title: Account Director, Enterprise
description:
About the Role:

The Account Director, Enterprise leads client relationships and plays a critical role in retention and growth. This role is high-impact, client-facing, and contributes directly to revenue through individual and pod quota ownership.

In this role, you will develop strategic campaigns, build and expand executive relationships, develop expertise in Fetch’s offerings, and apply tools and workflows to improve accuracy and efficiency across your pod. As an experienced account professional, you’ll lead strategic conversations, shape account progression, and coach others while expanding Fetch’s impact. You are expected to leverage AI-enabled tools and workflows to drive efficiencies, improve data accuracy, and enhance client engagement.

This is a full-time role that can be held from one of our US offices or remotely in the United States.

Role Responsibilities:
  • Own individual revenue targets and contribute to pod revenue goals
  • Develop strategies to retain and grow top-tier partnerships, driving strategic long-term partnerships and success
  • Lead executive-level client relationships as the primary point of contact, facilitating strategic conversations, managing key touchpoints, and building consultative trust through clear communication and consistent follow-through.
  • Strategize against deadlines and navigate evolving priorities, modeling resilience for the broader team
  • Oversee client health by monitoring satisfaction, addressing risks early, and surfacing opportunities to expand relationships
  • Ensure the successful execution of partner deliverables such as campaign performance, one-off requests, and analytics requests.
  • Collaborate closely with your sales counterpart to identify optimization opportunities, drive upsells, and expand Fetch’s share of partner budgets using data and trend analysis.
  • Facilitate the onboarding of new clients and brands, campaign set up, and coordination of materials, so partnerships launch smoothly and expectations are met from the start. Utilize AI-enabled platforms to ensure precision and efficiency.
  • Oversee inputs for campaign setup and programming, using standardized workflows and templates to ensure accuracy and minimize errors
  • Partner with internal teams to track, organize, troubleshoot, and optimize client performance, leveraging AI tools to proactively detect trends or performance risks
  • Serve as a key internal leader in developing and mentoring new team members. Support AI skill development and AI process adoption across the team
  • Ensure clients have access to timely reporting to guide budget allocation, leveraging dashboards to improve transparency and decision-making.
  • Independently provide partners with access to the data and reporting needed to optimize budget allocation and increase spend, using AI-generated dashboards and insights to surface key opportunities
  • Translate data and performance trends into clear, actionable recommendations for clients.
  • Independently deliver client presentations and reviews, including QBRs, using AI to translate complex data into clear insights with visual narratives that drive strategic action.
  • Oversee revenue actualizations and billing processes, ensuring financial records are accurate and compliant
  • Utilize sales-enablement, AI, automation tools and demonstrate a growth mindset toward adopting new technologies and workflows to increase efficiency
  • Play an active role in hiring and shaping Fetch’s partner manager team culture and structure
  • Demonstrate Fetch's values with a growth mindset, especially toward new tools and AI-assisted workflows

Minimum Requirements:
  • 8+ years of experience in account management, partnerships, sales support, or a related field
  • Direct industry experience in digital media, advertising, or consumer data
  • Experience driving revenue through renewals, upsells, and client growth conversations
  • Strong organizational and execution skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities
  • Expert in analyzing campaign data and presenting insights to clients or internal stakeholders to drive business outcomes
  • Familiarity with AI tools (ex. ChatGPT, Gemini AI) or automation platforms (ex. Zapier) and creating new AI-enabled processes
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills
  • Comfort working in dynamic or evolving environments
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience

Preferred Requirements:
  • Direct client vertical experience
  • Experienced with CRM tools (ex. Salesforce)
  • Experience coaching and collaborating with implementation, analytics, or other cross-functional teams

title: (CAN) Solution Consultant II
description:
Position Summary...

As a Solution Consultant II, you will support in delivering technology-driven solutions that address complex business challenges. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, engage with stakeholders, and ensure the successful implementation of solutions that align with Walmart’s strategic objectives. You will also ensure existing warehouse solutions runs as designed and available to business operations every day.

What you'll do...

Key Responsibilities:

  • Partner with business and technical teams to understand requirements and design effective solutions.
  • Support solution design sessions and present recommendations to stakeholders.
  • Support development of solution architectures, workflows, and technical specifications.
  • Support implementation and integration of solutions, ensuring alignment with Walmart’s standards.
  • Provide subject matter expertise and guidance on warehouse solution throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvement and innovation.
  • Support change management and user adoption activities.
  • Create comprehensive solution security plans and documentation to obtain InfoSec (Information Security) approval for new and existing solutions.
  • Support management of 3rd party vendor relationship and applications.
  • Support incident and problem management for existing technology in operations, working closely with operational teams to drive issue resolution and continuous improvement.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Business, or related field.
  • 1-3 years of experience in solution consulting, business analysis, or a related role.
  • Strong understanding of Warehouse Management Systems, cloud technologies, and integration patterns.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Proven ability to lead complex projects and deliver results in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience in retail or e-commerce is a plus.
  • Experience with supply chain processes and technologies is highly preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience with warehouse automation solutions is strongly desired.
  • Experience with vendor management, governance, and IT incident/problem management practices preferred.
  • Strong analytical skills with both qualitative and quantitative data.
  • Travel required to various sites across the GTA.


Leadership Expectations:

Respect the Individual:

Demonstrates and encourages respect for others; drives a positive associate and customer experience for all; embraces differences in people, cultures, ideas, and experiences; supports workplaces where associated feel seen and connected through a culture of belonging, so all associates thrive and perform; contributes to an environment allowing everyone to bring their best selves to work.

Demonstrates engagement and commitment to the team, developing others through feedback, coaching, mentoring, and developmental opportunities; and recognizes others’ contributions and accomplishments.

Builds strong and trusting relationships with team members and business partners; works collaboratively to achieve objectives; communicates with impact and listens attentively to a range of audiences; and demonstrates energy and positivity for own work.

Acts with Integrity:

Maintains and promotes the highest standards of integrity, ethics and compliance; models the Walmart values and leads by example to foster our culture; supports Walmart’s goal of becoming a regenerative company by making a positive impact for associates, customers, and the world around us (e.g., creating a sense of belonging, eliminating waste, participating in local giving).

Follows the law, our code of conduct and company policies, and encourages others to do the same; supports an environment where associates feel comfortable sharing concerns; reinforces our culture of non-retaliation; listens to concerns raised by associates and takes action; acts with accountability for achieving results in a way that is consistent with our values.

Is consistently humble, self-aware, honest, and transparent.

Serve our Customers:

Delivers results while putting the customer first and applying an omni-merchant mindset and acts with an Every Day Low Cost mindset to drive value and Every Day Low Prices for customers.

Adopts a broad perspective that considers data, analytics, customer insights, and different parts of the business when making plans.

Strive for Excellence:

Consistently raises the bar and seeks to improve; demonstrates curiosity and a growth mindset; seeks feedback, asks thoughtful questions; supports innovation and intelligent risk-taking; and exhibits resilience in the face of setbacks.

Implements and supports continuous improvements and willingly embraces new digital tools and ways of working.

title: Vendor Managed Inventory Planner
description:
About the Role:

We have a current opening for a Vendor Managed Inventory (VMI) Planner and are actively reviewing applications.

The Vendor Management Inventory (VMI) Planner is a part of the Ferrero Customer Logistics team within the Supply Chain organization. This is a key customer facing role, supporting the day-to-day VMI operations between FUSA and our VMI integrated customers. Additionally, the VMI Planner will work strategically with the VMI Manager to identify continuous improvement opportunities and develop best practices that translate to cost savings by reducing customer returns & refusals, out of region shipments, and increasing overall Supply Chain efficiency. This position requires exceptional data analytical skills as well as strong systems navigation competencies.

The VMI Planner will work cross-functionally to ensure product availability and timely deployment. This position is also responsible for meeting customer inventory and service level targets. The VMI Planner is responsible for forecasting customer weekly replenishment needs and efficient purchase order cadence, while maintaining targeted inventory levels and overall support of customer every-day, seasonal, and promotional portfolio requirements.

Main Responsibilities:

The VMI Planner is responsible for leading the execution of inventory replenishment and order execution. Key responsibilities include:


• Submit customer purchase orders as needed to maintain in-stock inventory levels and optimize Supply Chain fill rate & on time (OTIF) performance metrics.
• Work with cross functional teams to ensure seamless replenishment execution.
• Optimize cost savings via order/truckload/shipment saturation.
• Deliver on Customer and Ferrero key KPIs of fill-rate & on time (OTIF) in conjunction with claims, returns, and refusal reductions.


VMI Planner Accountabilities:
• Lead VMI order execution.
• Provide uninterrupted support of customer inventory levels and supply chain efficiencies.
• Identify and escalate system or process inefficiencies that negatively impact customer in-stock position or supply chain optimization.
• Identify system and/or process improvement opportunities to the VMI manager, cross-functional teams, and customer stakeholders.
• Work in a matrix capacity within supply chain, sales, and transportation teams to prioritize orders and ensure complete fulfillment for seasonal and everyday order volume.
• Maintain accurate replenishment forecasts by analyzing sales data, monitoring inventory positions and customer (OTIF) performance levels
• Generate Supply Chain cost savings through order saturation (mix and volume) and truckload optimization.

About You:

· Bachelor’s degree in supply chain management, Logistics, or Business Administration
· 3-4 Years Supply Chain / Customer Logistics / VMI (preferred)
· 3-4 Years of SAP/CRM

Competencies
· Problem Solving
· Systems Navigation
· Business Acumen
· Drive for Results
· Matrix Communication skills
· Dealing With Ambiguity
· Process Management skills
· Prioritization skills


Skills
· VMI & EDI Preferred
· Strong SAP / CRM Systems navigation experience
· Intermediate skills in Microsoft Excel (VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables)

These tools are used solely to support recruiters by summarizing application information and identifying potential alignment with job requirements. AI does not independently screen out or select candidates, and it does not replace human judgment. Final decisions regarding candidate progression are always made by Ferrero recruiters and hiring managers.

Careers with caring built in - discover our benefits here.

In addition to base salary, we offer a comprehensive benefits package, including health insurance, retirement plans, paid time off, and other benefits.

R-2658951

title: Senior Analyst, Business Analysis And Insights - GIS
description:
Position Summary...

This role combines strong geospatial and technology expertise with structured problem solving to help the business address complex and ambiguous challenges. The role partners closely with stakeholders to understand business needs, develop the right analytical approach, and translate GIS capabilities into scalable products, tools, and solutions that support better strategic and operational decisions. Success in this role requires both strong technical execution and the ability to connect data, geography, and business context to create practical, high-impact outcomes.

What you'll do...

  • Solve complex, high-impact business problems through geospatial analysis, spatial modeling, data, and technology, translating analytical approaches into scalable solutions that support better decisions.
  • Build and automate scalable geospatial workflows using CARTO, BigQuery, GCP, Python, SQL, APIs, and related cloud and spatial technologies, with a focus on reusable and maintainable solutions.
  • Design and build scalable geospatial products, analytical solutions, and decision-support tools from concept and methodology through development, enabling business teams to explore scenarios, test assumptions, and make informed decisions.
  • Develop geospatial models and methodologies for strategic problems such as site selection, trade areas, market opportunity, network planning, cannibalization, customer accessibility, and location optimization.
  • Work with demographic, customer, market, competitive, and location data to understand customers, market potential, geographic differences, competitive dynamics, and network impacts.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to frame ambiguous challenges, define requirements, and translate them into practical geospatial, analytical, and technical solutions.
  • Translate complex geospatial analysis into clear insights, compelling visualizations, and practical recommendations for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Proactively identify and apply new geospatial, cloud, automation, and emerging technologies, while collaborating with data science, engineering, and cross-functional teams to strengthen analytical capabilities.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or master’s degree in Geography, GIS, Geomatics, Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Urban Planning, or another relevant quantitative discipline; an advanced degree is an asset.
  • 4+ years of relevant professional experience in geospatial analytics, data science, advanced analytics, location intelligence, software/analytical product development, consulting, or related field.
  • Demonstrated experience applying geospatial analysis, spatial modeling, and large-scale spatial datasets to solve complex business problems.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Python, SQL, Big Query, CARTO, other relevant GIS technologies, and modern cloud data platforms eg: GCP.
  • Demonstrated experience building models, automated workflows, analytical tools, or geospatial data products.
  • Strong understanding of core geospatial concepts, including co-ordinate systems and projections, spatial relationships, network analysis, geocoding, and vector/raster data
  • Experience in retail, real estate, strategy, network planning, eCommerce, consulting, or location intelligence is highly valued.
  • Experience using Generative AI or LLM-based tools to accelerate development, automate workflows, support analysis, prototype solutions, or enhance existing data products is an asset.

The pay range for this position is $74 000,00 - $101 750,00. Pay will be determined based on relevant experience.

title: Senior Windows Systems Engineer - Hybrid
description:
Grow Your Career at Cedars-Sinai

We were recently named one of the “Best Places to Work in IT” by Computerworld and ranked #2 among large organizations for hybrid work.

The organization’s Healthtech excellence was acknowledged again through the esteemed CHIME Digital Health Most Wired recognition program. Cedars-Sinai was assigned a Level 10—the most prestigious level of certification—among more than 300 surveyed healthcare organizations. Cedars-Sinai earned high scores across multiple verticals and particularly excelled in infrastructure, interoperability, and population health innovation.

Why Work Here

Beyond an outstanding benefits package and competitive salaries, we take pride in hiring the best and most committed employees. Our staff reflects the culturally and ethnically diverse community we serve. They demonstrate our dedication to creating a multifaceted, inclusive environment that fuels innovation and supports the gold standard of patient care we strive for.

What Will You Be Doing in This Role:

The Senior Windows Platform Engineer role works to ensure that technology services and infrastructure throughout the company operate at peak performance. The role provides technical mentorship and performs the engineering activities required to build, support, automate, and continuously improve a large, sophisticated on-premises and cloud-based computing environment. The Senior Engineer applies standard methodologies for enterprise management, architecture, configuration, disaster recovery, administration, automation, incident management, and operational support.

  • Investigate complex system-level early-design engineering proofs of concept and prototypes.
  • Provision, configure, and maintain cloud resources, including service instances, load balancers, security groups, DNS, certificates, and related services.
  • Perform cloud computing environment buildouts, site setup, user training, hardware and software installation, maintenance, support, and documentation of operating procedures and processes.
  • Design, configure, implement, and support automated workflows for Windows Server provisioning and post-build configuration, including PowerShell and Desired State Configuration (DSC).
  • Develop, test, document, and maintain automation scripts and processes that improve consistency, security, and operational efficiency across the data center.
  • Develop and design high-availability solutions and standards. Build and design solutions that mitigate risk and increase efficiency within IT.
  • Evaluate and certify hardware platforms for use in a data center environment. Cisco UCS experience is preferred.
  • Provide advanced technical support and L3 troubleshooting.
  • Participate in incident management, root-cause analysis, and problem resolution.
  • Serve as a senior escalation point for critical incidents, including P1 support.
  • Coordinate with operations, vendors, and manufacturers to restore service and communicate status through resolution.
  • Assist with the development and testing of changes needed to maintain the disaster recovery environment.
  • Design and implement event automation and event-driven operational workflows to detect, correlate, notify, and remediate infrastructure events.
  • Plan and execute Windows Server end-of-life refreshes, including discovery, compatibility assessment, migration or replacement planning, implementation, validation, documentation, and retirement of legacy systems.
  • Lead or contribute to server builds and infrastructure architecture, including requirements gathering, standards, capacity planning, high availability, security, disaster recovery, and lifecycle management.

  • Provide on-call or after-hours support as required for critical infrastructure incidents and P1 response.

Hybrid Remote: Must currently live in the Los Angeles area or be willing to relocate to the Los Angeles area to meet onsite requirements.

Experience Requirements:

Five (5) or more years of experience as a Windows Server or Systems Engineer in a complex, multi-platform, multi-protocol enterprise environment.

Hands-on experience with Windows Server operating systems, including pre-build planning, server builds, post-build configuration, workload provisioning, and lifecycle refreshes.

Experience with operating system automation, PowerShell, Desired State Configuration (DSC), event automation, and infrastructure-as-code or configuration-management practices.

Experience supporting incident management processes, critical incidents, P1 response, troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and service restoration in an enterprise environment.

Experience designing or implementing server architecture, high availability, disaster recovery, and secure infrastructure standards.

Solid grasp of server and systems monitoring, analysis, management, configuration, event management, and automation tools.

Deep hands-on experience with Windows Server operating systems, including pre- and post-installation configuration, workload provisioning, server builds, and technical cloud architecture.

Experience with backup client/server software.

Experience with cluster and high-availability software.

Experience with remote server builds and infrastructure deployment.

Solid grasp of converged and hyper converged technologies.

IT security experience and the ability to plan, implement, and administer Windows-based IT systems in accordance with security and operational standards.

Familiarity with Java and middleware products. IIS experience is preferred.

Educational and Certification Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.

MCSE and/or AWS certifications, or equivalent experience, preferred.

Extensive knowledge of Microsoft server products, licensing, and applications.

Energetic, Fast-Paced Environment

R-2660845

title: Consultant/Senior Consultant - Functional - Salesforce
description:
We are looking for an experienced Salesforce QA Engineer to plan, design, and execute comprehensive testing strategies for complex Salesforce implementations.The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in functional, integration, and regression testing, along with the ability to validate both declarative and customised Salesforce solutions across multiple Salesforce Clouds.Strong hands-on experience in Salesforce Experience Cloud testing is mandatory, along with a solid understanding of Sales Cloud and Service Cloud functionalities.

Key Responsibilities

1. Salesforce Clouds
Experience Cloud (Mandatory)
  • Hands-on experience testing Salesforce Experience Cloud community portals.
  • Validate portal navigation, page layouts, templates, and overall user experience.
  • Test guest and external user access, login and registration workflows.
  • Validate sharing, record visibility, and access permissions for partner and customer personas.
Sales Cloud & Service Cloud
  • Strong understanding of core CRM processes, including lead-to-cash workflows and case management.
  • Experience testing omnichannel routing and standard Salesforce object architectures.
  • Ability to design and execute end-to-end business scenarios across Sales and Service Cloud.
2. Functional Testing & Salesforce Platform Validation
  • Test Planning & Design: Analyse user stories and acceptance criteria, prepare test plans, scenarios, and test cases covering positive, negative, and edge cases. Maintain requirement-to-test traceability.
  • Manual, Regression & UAT Testing: Perform functional, integration, smoke, regression, and UAT testing across Salesforce Sandbox environments. Manage defect logging, triage, retesting, and closure.
  • Declarative Automation Testing: Validate Salesforce Flows (Screen, Record-Triggered, and Schedule-Triggered), validation rules, approval processes, and legacy Process Builder and Workflow Rules.
  • Apex, Triggers & LWC Validation: Functionally validate custom Apex logic, triggers, and Lightning Web Components, including bulk data scenarios and governor limit behaviour. Use Debug Logs and Developer Console to investigate failures.
  • SOQL & SOSL: Demonstrate strong proficiency in SOQL and basic knowledge of SOSL for data verification, record validation, and troubleshooting.
  • Security Model Testing: Validate Salesforce security configurations, including OWD, Sharing Rules, Profiles, Permission Sets, Role Hierarchy, and Field-Level Security. Perform role-based access and "Run As" user testing.
3. Test Automation
  • Apex Test Classes & Code Coverage: Ability to review Apex test classes, understand code coverage reports, and collaborate with developers to ensure the minimum 75% code coverage requirement is met.
  • LWC Jest Testing: Basic to intermediate understanding of Jest-based unit testing for Lightning Web Components.
4. API, Integration & Data Testing
  • API Testing: Experience testing REST and SOAP APIs, JSON/XML payloads, and webhooks using tools such as Postman and Workbench. Understand authentication mechanisms, including OAuth, Connected Apps, and Named Credentials.
  • Integration Testing: Validate end-to-end data flows between Salesforce, external systems, middleware, and third-party applications, including negative and failure scenarios.
  • Data Migration & Test Data Management: Use Salesforce Data Loader, Import Wizard, and Workbench for test data creation, migration validation, and data reconciliation, including Large Data Volume (LDV) scenarios.
5. Analytics & AI Testing
  • Reports & Dashboards: Validate custom report types, filters, dashboards, and snapshot reporting against underlying Salesforce data.
  • Einstein Features: Test Salesforce Einstein capabilities, such as Einstein Bots, Next Best Action, and Einstein Analytics, ensuring expected recommendations and outcomes.
  • Agentforce: Familiarity with testing autonomous AI agents and AI-driven workflows, including prompt and response validation, topics, actions, guardrails, and Agentforce testing tools.
6. DevOps, Release Management & QA Tools
  • Release & Environment Management: Understand Salesforce release lifecycles and Sandbox strategies across Dev, QA, UAT, and Staging environments. Perform data seeding, Sandbox refresh validation, and post-deployment smoke and regression testing.
  • Deployment Tools: Working knowledge of deployments using Change Sets, Salesforce CLI (SFDX), or Gearset. Validate deployment results and troubleshoot deployment-related issues.
  • CI/CD & Quality Gates: Familiarity with Salesforce DevOps pipelines and tools such as Copado and Gearset, including automated testing and deployment validation as quality gates.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • 3–5 years of hands-on experience in Salesforce QA.
  • Strong practical knowledge of Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Experience Cloud.
  • Mandatory hands-on experience in Experience Cloud testing.
  • Strong understanding of functional, integration, regression, and UAT testing.
  • Experience in test planning, test case preparation, defect management, and requirement traceability.
  • Proficiency in Salesforce Flows, SOQL, security model validation, and data testing.
  • Working knowledge of Apex test classes, code coverage, and LWC validation.
  • Experience in REST/SOAP API testing, Postman, Workbench, and Data Loader.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce deployment processes, Sandbox management, and DevOps tools.

Good to Have Skills

  • Apex Debug Logs and Developer Console.
  • Security Model and Run As testing.
  • Exploratory testing.
  • Jest testing for Lightning Web Components.
  • MuleSoft integration testing and OAuth 2.0 flows.
  • Data Cloud and CRM Analytics.
  • Agentforce testing and AI-driven workflow validation.
  • Salesforce CLI (SFDX), Change Sets, Gearset, and Copado.
  • Copado Robotic Testing.

Preferred Certifications

  • Salesforce Certified Administrator – Required
  • Salesforce Certified Experience Cloud Consultant – Highly Preferred
  • Salesforce Certified Sales Cloud Consultant / Service Cloud Consultant – Highly Preferred
  • Salesforce Certified Platform App Builder – Good to Have.
  • Salesforce Certified Platform Developer I – Good to Have.
  • Salesforce Certified Agentforce Specialist / AI Associate – Good to Have.

title: (CAN) Manager, Project and Construction (IC)
description:
Position Summary...

The Manager, Project and Construction will have a specialty in overseeing and coordinating HVAC and Refrigeration construction and facility projects, ensuring timely and budget-compliant delivery while adhering to industry, regulatory, and company standards. They will also support in managing and coordinating other facility categorized projects as needed. This role significantly contributes to the company's growth through expertise in commercial HVAC and refrigeration practices and environmental standards.

What you'll do...

Job Description

The Manager, Project and Construction Manages large-scale, cross-functional maintenance programs, including capital projects, facility retrofits, and energy-efficiency initiatives. Collaborates with internal stakeholders and external service providers to ensure projects are delivered safely, on time, and within budget. Monitors project schedules, milestones, resource allocation, and financial performance to ensure alignment with organizational priorities and operational objectives.


Provides leadership and direction to a team of Managers and Supervisors by delivering coaching, performance feedback, and development opportunities. Builds and sustains a high-performing, safety-focused maintenance organization through strategic workforce planning, technical training, and succession planning. Fosters a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and operational excellence by establishing clear performance expectations and conducting regular performance evaluations.


Develops and manages regional project budgets, including labor, materials, operating expenses, and capital expenditures. Evaluates the return on investment of maintenance initiatives and identifies cost reduction opportunities through vendor management, process improvements, and operational efficiencies. Ensures accurate forecasting, financial reporting, and budget control. Maintains compliance with company policies by reviewing and approving corporate card transactions, associate time records, and expenditures to verify alignment with approved scopes of work and budgetary guidelines.


Ensures compliance with all applicable federal, provincial/state, and local regulations, including refrigerant management, mechanical licensing, and environmental requirements. Conducts audits and inspections to identify and mitigate operational risks, including vehicle safety audits, inventory verification, equipment condition assessments, work order documentation reviews, and adherence to operational standards. Partners closely with Safety and Compliance teams to maintain regulatory compliance and uphold company standards.


Drives the execution of strategic business plans and maintenance initiatives by identifying operational needs, establishing priorities, allocating resources, and removing barriers to performance. Develops and communicates actionable plans, defines performance metrics, measures progress, and implements corrective actions as needed. Demonstrates adaptability, supports continuous learning, and develops contingency plans to ensure sustained operational effectiveness and business continuity.

Respect the Individual:

title: Program Coordinator 1 (PCN 07-5544)
description:
Job Description

ATTENTION ALASKA RESIDENTS!

The Department of Labor and Workforce Development, Division of AVTEC, is recruiting for a
Program Coordinator 1 located in Seward!
No Cover Letter Required!



This position is in the General Government Unit (GGU) at a Range 18.


What You Will Be Doing:
As a Program Coordinator, you will serve as a subject matter expert responsible for all activities involved in the planning, implementation, administration, oversight, evaluation and reporting of workforce development grant programs and student service initiatives at the Alaska Vocational Technical Center (AVTEC). This includes the administration of state and/or federal funds for programs including, but not limited to, Workforce Innovation and Opportunity Act.

You'll work closely with students, instructors, employers, and community partners to coordinate services, remove barriers to success, and improve employment outcomes. In addition, you will plan and support student engagement activities and other initiatives that enhance the student experience. This position offers a unique opportunity to combine program leadership, grant management, and direct student support to make a meaningful impact on the lives of Alaskans.

Our Mission, Values, and Culture:
The Alaska Vocational Technical Center (AVTEC) trains Alaskans for work in the trades. Our motto is "start a career in less than a year" and the mission is to deliver flexible, accessible and affordable workforce training that is responsive to the dynamic needs of business and industry and serve Alaska's diverse communities. The mission is realized through our day-to-day operations, where staff and instructors collaborate to ensure the success of AVTEC students in completing training and securing employment post-training.

Benefits of Joining Our Team:
The most significant benefit of being an employee at AVTEC is that you will work within an organization that provides better opportunities for Alaskans. As a member of the staff within a Division of the State of Alaska, you are employed by the State of Alaska and, as such, are offered paid leave accrual, retirement, and health benefits. We believe in a healthy work-life balance and a safe working environment, and we provide opportunities to pursue these daily.

The Working Environment You Can Expect:
AVTEC is located in Seward, a small and friendly community situated at the head of Resurrection Bay; amenities such as coffee shops, retail stores, and restaurants are all within walking distance of any AVTEC campus, and beautiful nature trails and a great walking and biking path are just steps away from the office door. The working environment and culture are friendly, flexible, and supportive.

Who We Are Looking For:
We are interested in candidates who possess some or all of the following position specific competencies:
  • Program Oversight: Plans, coordinates, and monitors programs to ensure that federal, state, and/or local government program requirements and plans are met, providing professional consultation on the specialized services of the program or associated project(s).
  • Partnering: Develops networks and builds alliances; collaborates across boundaries to build strategic relationships and achieve common goals.
  • Self-Management: Sets well-defined and realistic personal goals; displays a high level of initiative, effort, and commitment towards completing assignments in a timely manner; works with minimal supervision; is motivated to achieve; demonstrates responsible behavior.

To view the general description and example of duties for the position, please go to the following link:

Minimum Qualifications

Competency Based Minimum Qualifications Instructions:
This job class uses competency based minimum qualifications. Please ensure your application (through work history, volunteer experience (duties summary), training, education, licenses, certifications, etc.) supports how you have gained the knowledge, skills, abilities, and behaviors (competencies) and that you possess the minimum required competencies for the job class.

Competency Description
The competency description(s) listed below have been designed to promote a common understanding of the essential elements of the job class. They highlight the more general and customary knowledge, skills, abilities (KSAs), tasks, and behaviors used to describe the competency. They typically list expectations, as opposed to specific tasks, and are to be used only as parameters and guidelines. A competency’s description is not intended to exclusively define every KSA, task, and behavior needed to successfully meet the competency, but rather to provide the manager/agency with a broad reference of options as to how an applicant can meet the job expectation.

Minimum Qualifications:
Any combination of education and/or experience that provides the applicant with competencies in:

  • Analytical Thinking/Problem Solving: Uses a logical, systematic, sequential approach to address problems or opportunities or manage a situation by drawing on one’s knowledge and experience base and calling on other references and resources as necessary.
  • Compliance: Knowledge of procedures for assessing, evaluating, and monitoring programs or projects for compliance with Federal laws, regulations, and guidance.
  • Decision Making: Makes sound, well-informed, and objective decisions; perceives the impact and implications of decisions; commits to action, even in uncertain situations, to accomplish organizational goals; causes change.
  • Planning and Evaluating: Organizes work, sets priorities, and determines resource requirements; determines short- or long-term goals and strategies to achieve them; coordinates with other organizations or parts of the organization to accomplish goals; monitors progress and evaluates outcomes.


Equivalent to those typically gained by:
Training from an accredited college or university in any field and/or progressively responsible experience assisting with planning, coordinating, and implementing administrative controls, work processes, and/or procedures for a program, project, business, or organization.

Special Note:
“Competencies” means a combination of interrelated knowledge, skills, abilities, and behaviors that enable a person to act effectively in a job or situation.

“Typically gained by” means the prevalent, usual method of gaining the competencies expected for entry into the job.

“Training” and “education” are synonyms for the process of acquiring knowledge and skills through instruction. It includes instruction through formal and informal methods (such as classroom, on-line, self-study, and on-the-job), from accredited and unaccredited sources, and long-duration (such as a post-secondary degree) and short-duration (such as a seminar) programs.

“Progressively responsible” means indicating growth and/or advancement in complexity, difficulty, or level of responsibility.

Take pride in helping customers save money and live better.

title: Physical Therapy Upper Extremity Fellow
description:
Work Schedule:
100% FTE, 40 hours/week. Shifts scheduled Monday – Wednesday 9:00 AM – 6:30 PM, Thursday 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM, and Friday 7:00 AM – 5:00 PM.

Be part of something remarkable

Expedite your professional growth through didactic work, one-on-one clinical mentoring, research activities, outreach experiences, multi-disciplinary educational lectures, sports performance experiences, and case presentations. Broaden your scope of sports medicine practice by having the opportunity to work with youth, high school, college, and professional athletes.

We are seeking a Sports Physical Therapy Upper Extremity Fellow to:

  • Teach and participate in didactic education designed to advance clinical reasoning and pattern recognition in sports medicine and sports physical therapy.
  • Challenge their own and others’ clinical decision making through constructive feedback in didactic units and case presentations.
  • Form alliances with patients and their families with the common goal of optimizing function and return to sport following acute injuries, surgical procedures and non-traumatic impairments.
  • Learn advanced level clinical biomechanics for evaluation and treatment in our upper extremity specialty clinics – swimmers, throwers, tactical athletes and strength and power.
  • Participate in Sports Performance coaching and training with professional volleyball and professional baseball players.
  • Receive and modify practice patterns based on constructive feedback from mentors.
  • Participate in education by teaching in the sports medicine education series, the sports medicine symposium, and various outreach programs.
  • Collaborate on a weekly basis with board certified and fellowship trained sports medicine physicians and surgeons, including working as a physician extender in clinic and surgical observations.
  • Work in our state-of-the-art facilities – including the 28,000 square foot sports rehab facility at East Madison Hospital that has an indoor turf field, two pools, a basketball court, a golf hitting area, a sprint track and functionally based weight room.
  • Participate in mentor guided sports medicine projects.

Additional Information:

  • This position spends six months training in Dunedin, FL with the Toronto Blue Jays organization (March-August). What you can expect:
    • Athletic training room care and field coverage of spring training and regular season games with certified athletic trainers and physical therapists.
    • Injury prevention of healthy Major and Minor League Baseball Players.
    • Injury rehabilitation of Major and Minor League Baseball Players.
    • Learning opportunities with other high-performance departments (mental skills, sports science, strength/conditioning, nutrition).
    • Opportunities for observation/learning with Major League Baseball Team Physicians.


Please submit the following items with your application:

  • Cover letter detailing the reason for an application to the fellowship program
  • 3 letters of reference
  • Current resume/CV


At UW Health, you will have:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Physical Therapy Required or

  • Licensed or eligible for licensure as a Physical Therapist in the State of Wisconsin; staff assigned to the Toronto Blue Jays training facility in Florida must hold or be eligible for licensure in the State of Florida. Upon Hire Required
  • Certified athletic trainer or EMT or have taken an approved Emergency Responder course Upon Hire Required

title: Claims Representative
description:
Chubb is currently seeking a Workers’ Compensation Medical Only Claim Representative for our Northeast, New York, and New Jersey Region. The successful applicant will be handling claims from Vermont, New Hampshire, Massachusetts, Rhode Island, Connecticut, New York, and New Jersey. The position will report to, and reside in, our New Haven, Connecticut office.

Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Handles all aspects of workers’ compensation medical only claims from set-up to case closure, ensuring strong customer relations are maintained throughout the process.

  • Reviews claim and policy information to provide background for the investigation.

  • Conducts three-part ongoing investigations, obtaining facts and taking statements as necessary, with the insured, claimant, and medical providers.

  • Evaluates the facts gathered through the investigation to determine the compensability of the medical treatment.

  • Inform insureds and claimants of claim denials when applicable.

  • Prepares reports on investigations, settlements, denials of claims, evaluations of involved parties, etc.

  • Timely administration of statutory medical only benefits throughout the life of the claim.

  • Sets reserves within authority limits for medical and expenses and recommends reserve changes to Team Leader throughout the life of the claim.

  • Reviews the claim status at regular intervals and makes recommendations to Team Leader to discuss problems and remedial actions to resolve them.

  • Prepares and submits to Team Leader unusual or possible undesirable exposures when encountered.

  • Controls and directs vendors, nurse case managers, and telephonic case managers on medical management.

  • Complies with customer service requests, including Special Claims Handling procedures and file status notes.

  • Submits workers’ compensation forms and electronic data to states to ensure compliance with statutory regulations.

  • Refers appropriate claims to subrogation and secures necessary information to ensure that recovery opportunities are maximized.

  • Works with in-house Technical Assistants, Special Investigators, Nurse

  • Consultants, Telephonic Case Managers and Team Supervisors to exceed customers' expectations for exceptional claim handling service.

Technical Skills & Competencies:

  • Knowledge of insurance, claims, and workers’ compensation statutes, regulations, and compliance is a plus, but on-the-job training will be provided to the chosen applicant.

  • Ability to incorporate data analytics and modeling into daily activities to expedite the fair and equitable resolution of claims and claim issues.

  • A personal commitment to superior performance that adds value to our company and our customers.

  • Ability to work effectively with a wide variety of people.

  • An aptitude for evaluating, analyzing, and interpreting information.

  • Superior telephonic skills.

  • Excellent organizational skills.

  • The ability to multi-task with proven time management skills to meet deadlines.

  • Ability to work well in teams.

  • Demonstrate critical thinking and decision-making ability.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Experience, Education, & Requirements:

  • Experience working in a customer-focused, fast-paced, fluid environment

  • Experience utilizing strong communication and telephonic skills

  • Prior experience requiring a high level of organization, follow-up and accountability

  • Prior workers’ compensation claim handling experience is a plus but not required

  • Familiarity with claim handling (healthcare, short-term / long-term disability, auto personal injury protection, medical injury, or general liability) is a plus but not required

  • Prior insurance, medical billing, legal or corporate business experience is a plus but not required

  • AIC, RMA, or CPCU-completed coursework or designation(s) is a plus but not required

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Products

  • Knowledge of medical terminology is a plus but not required

  • Knowledge of bill processing is a plus but not required

  • Claim adjuster licenses in Connecticut (all casualty lines), New Hampshire (workers’ compensation), Rhode Island (workers’ compensation), and Vermont (workers’ compensation) are required.

  • If any applicant does not have the required licenses, in current standing, the applicant will have three (3) attempts or three (3) months, whichever is sooner, from the date-of-hire, to acquire the necessary licenses.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Products

The pay range for the role is $57,200 to $80,300. The specific offer will depend on an applicant’s skills and other factors. This role may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program. Chubb offers a comprehensive benefits package, more details on which can be found on our careers website. The disclosed pay range estimate may be adjusted for the applicable geographic differential for the location in which the position is filled.

description:
Position Summary...

The Pharmacy Assistant assists the Pharmacist in the technical aspects of prescription filling and administrative duties in order to increase the Pharmacist's opportunity to provide patient care. The Pharmacy Assistant is expected to participate in all aspects of Pharmacy Operations required of a team player. They are a key member in the delivery of superior customer service.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Who We Are

At Murmuration, we believe that America’s promise is shaped and reshaped by the best ideas and ideals of its communities, and the dreams of the people who believe in a better life for themselves, their families, and each other.

We help organizations build power in their communities in four key ways: we organize a network of values-aligned partners; we provide deep, data-driven insights into people, places, and perspectives; we develop tools that make organizing and engagement easy and more effective; and we offer services that strengthen our partners’ capacity to lead change in their communities.

We envision an America where every community has what it needs to help people lead healthy, free, and dignified lives. We work to redesign the systems and structures we all depend on — how we learn, live, govern, and solve problems — so that they are just, equitable, resilient, and rooted in shared responsibility. By strengthening the ties that hold communities together, we aim for civic life defined by collective action and care, with effective leadership that truly represents everyone.

We are a collaborative, curious, and creative team of organizers, scientists, teachers, technologists, campaign veterans, and more who share the unwavering belief that we can use our gifts in service of transforming America — together. We’ve built our team guided by the belief that the whole is greater than the sum of its parts. And so we support each other relentlessly — rallying together to face challenges the same way we celebrate each other’s wins.

About the Position

Do you thrive in inclusive, thoughtful environments where engineers hold themselves to high standards of technical excellence, ownership, and impact at scale?

As a Senior Software Engineer, you’ll be responsible for designing, building, and evolving the systems and services that power the Organizer platform. You’ll tackle complex technical challenges, help shape architectural decisions, and play an important role in keeping our backend systems reliable, scalable, maintainable, and secure as we grow.

Your impact will go beyond the code you write. You’ll own problems from discovery through production, partnering closely with Product, Design, Engineering, and other stakeholders to turn ideas and requirements into thoughtful, effective solutions. You’ll also have opportunities to share your expertise and help raise the technical effectiveness of the engineers around you.

Job Level P4

What You’ll Do

  • Own outcomes, not just implementation: Understand the problem being solved and remain engaged through deployment and production;
  • Exercise technical judgment: Evaluate alternatives, identify tradeoffs, and recommend solutions appropriate to the problem rather than automatically choosing the most sophisticated approach;
  • Handle ambiguity: Identify missing information, ask the right questions, and move work forward when a solution has not already been defined;
  • Think beyond your immediate changes: Consider how decisions affect system reliability, maintainability, other services, and future engineering work;
  • Raise the effectiveness of the team: Share context, provide useful feedback, mentor others, and improve engineering practices;
  • Communicate early: Surface risks, uncertainty, dependencies, and changing assumptions before they become delivery problems; and
  • Leave systems better than you found them: Look for opportunities to improve reliability, documentation, testing, observability, and developer experience while delivering product work.

Requirements

  • Proven experience designing, developing, and maintaining backend software in production environments;
  • Strong understanding of software design principles and the ability to evaluate architectural tradeoffs;
  • Proven experience designing and maintaining APIs (e.g., GraphQL), distributed services, and data-intensive applications;
  • Proven experience debugging complex problems across services, infrastructure, and data;
  • Strong understanding of relational and/or NoSQL databases (MongoDB), including data modeling and query performance;
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills;
  • Proven experience collaborating effectively across Engineering, Product, and other disciplines;
  • Familiarity with incident management and logging, monitoring, and observability in production environments;
  • Familiarity with CI/CD practices and modern deployment environments;
  • Demonstrated mentorship and technical leadership in team settings;
  • Experience building modern JavaScript/TypeScript solutions; and
  • Experience working with event-driven or distributed architectures (e.g., AWS).

Nice to Haves

  • Formal degree optional; we welcome candidates from nontraditional or retraining paths;
  • Full-stack or open-source contributions;
  • Security and privacy-conscious system design;
  • Experience planning and executing database migrations and large-scale data operations;
  • Experience using AI tools/workflows; and/or
  • Experience in civic-tech, nonprofit, or data-driven social-impact products.

Talented Senior Software Engineers come from all walks of life and career. If you are passionate about civic engagement and technology, please apply, even if you do not check every box!

Benefits

Location and Compensation

The Senior Software Engineer is a full-time, salaried position with a comprehensive benefits package (detail below), open to candidates anywhere in the United States.

The starting salary for this position is $190,576. We set compensation using market data and apply it consistently across the organization to ensure fairness and transparency for everyone in similar roles.

Our Culture of Care

We work hard to create a culture of care to ensure that our staff are best equipped to lead happy, healthy, and balanced lives. To that end, we offer a comprehensive benefits package which includes:

  • Health, vision, and dental insurance with 100% of premiums covered for you and qualifying family members;
  • Retirement benefits with a 5% employer match;
  • A flexible unlimited PTO plan;
  • Generous paid parental leave;
  • Pre-tax commuter benefits;
  • A company laptop;
  • A flexible remote work environment;
  • A home office setup stipend for all new employees;
  • Monthly reimbursement for remote work expenses;
  • A yearly professional development fund;
  • Mental health and wellness benefits through Calm and Better Help;
  • Yearly in-person staff retreats; and
  • A welcoming culture that celebrates diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging.

At Murmuration, we believe a vibrant, representative democracy depends on the inclusion of diverse voices, lived experiences, and perspectives. The best ideas don’t come from a single person or ideology — they emerge at the intersection of different backgrounds, identities, and viewpoints. We are proud of our commitment to building an organization and culture shaped by respect, empathy, and collaboration, where our team’s diversity fuels innovation, civic engagement, and meaningful change. We welcome new colleagues who will help us nurture this collective effort. Join us.

An Equal-Opportunity Employer with a Commitment to Diversity

Murmuration is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and as an organization committed to diversity and the perspective of all voices, we consider applicants equally of race, gender, color, sexual orientation, religion, marital status, disability, political affiliation and national origin. We reasonably accommodate staff members and/or applicants with disabilities, provided they are otherwise able to perform the essential functions of the job.

Note: Murmuration is two organizations working together to pursue our mission of amplifying the power of civic engagement: Murmuration Research Institute, a 501(c)(3) that conducts research to identify, design, and create the data, tools, and insights that build healthier and more equitable communities; and Murmuration, Inc., a 501(c)(4) that supports organizations working across the country on the nation’s most challenging issues with access to data, tools, and research that build healthier and more equitable communities.

title: (CAN) Pharmacy Assistant
description:
Position Summary...

The Pharmacy Assistant assists the Pharmacist in the technical aspects of prescription filling and administrative duties in order to increase the Pharmacist's opportunity to provide patient care. The Pharmacy Assistant is expected to participate in all aspects of Pharmacy Operations required of a team player. They are a key member in the delivery of superior customer service.

General Housekeeping, stocking Prescription filling supplies (Vials, labels, bags), keeping the dispensary clean, organized and neat, maintaining clean/safe work environment as part of the team approach (i.e. dishes, garbage) and maintaining & cleaning packaging & dispensing equipment, computer, fax machine, etc.

description:

  • Must be customer service oriented – empathetic, responsive, patient, and conscientious.

  • Familiarity with corporate travel management solutions and/or related back-end systems like Sabre is preferred.

The process typically begins with an introductory call with a member of our Talent Acquisition team, where we'll discuss your background, career aspirations, and what makes Spotnana a great fit for you. Then a live virtual and onsite interview with a panel of engineers and hiring managers.

title: (CAN) Pharmacy Assistant
description:
Position Summary...

The Pharmacy Assistant assists the Pharmacist in the technical aspects of prescription filling and administrative duties in order to increase the Pharmacist's opportunity to provide patient care. The Pharmacy Assistant is expected to participate in all aspects of Pharmacy Operations required of a team player. They are a key member in the delivery of superior customer service.

What you'll do...

1. Receiving prescriptions from patients, following provincial legal/regulatory conditions and assessing the prescription for completeness i.e. Name; Address; DOB; Allergies; 3rd Party Information; Any Special Requests; Prescriber; Generic/Brand; Prioritizing Prescriptions with 21st Century Guidelines.
2. Performing Computer Functions as directed by the Pharmacist i.e. Data Entry; Price Check; Patient Information Entry/Update; Competent interpretation and processing of written prescriptions including Latin abbreviations, drug name recognition, dosage calculations; Refills; Report Generation; Patient Profile checks.
3. Filling prescriptions (always under the Pharmacist’s supervision), selecting appropriate products, performing the accuracy program, including 7 point, Visual and DIN checks, selecting and counting/ measuring & preparing appropriate products, labeling and organizing for pharmacist checking, gaining necessary approvals for verbal refills where authorized, employing 'STOP' forms if applicable and facilitating all aspects of Cognitive Services.
4. Maintaining Inventory Control, assisting Pharmacist in maintaining appropriate stock levels of drugs and supplies, checking for and pulling expired medications at least monthly, cleaning up Will Call Bin of 'stale' prescriptions on a regular basis, writing up returns, ordering of drugs and supplies, using preferred wholesaler for Pharmacy purchases as much as possible i.e. Kohl and Frisch, operating of the Telxon gun, checking off, pricing and putting away pharmacy orders, zoning the pharmacy shelves, 'X- ing' bottles when opened and interchangeable drug knowledge and appropriate maintenance/selection of key brands/preferred generics.
5. General Housekeeping, stocking Prescription filling supplies (Vials, labels, bags), keeping the dispensary clean, organized and neat, maintaining clean/safe work environment as part of the team approach (i.e. dishes, garbage) and maintaining & cleaning packaging & dispensing equipment, computer, fax machine, etc.
6. Clerical Organization, filing prescriptions, invoices, reports, correspondence and memos and completing any administrative support functions assigned (i.e. journals, accounts receivable, Aged Trial Balance).
7. Assisting with OTC Operations and ordering, stocking, cashier duties as assigned by OTC Manager and/or Pharmacist.

The pay range for this position is $20.15 - $26.42/hr. Rate of pay will be determined based on relevant experience.

  1. Leads the Request for Proposal (RFP) response pipeline by attending all planning meetings and providing answers to questions asked in RFP (other than pricing) with input from the leadership team regarding competitors and examples of comparable work.
  2. Interfaces with staff at all levels of the organization as well as clients and partners.

  7. Manage the RFP timeline and own the RFI & RFP deliverable and submittal in client portal.
  8. Need to meet submission deadlines.
  9. Actively involved in the development and maintenance of marketing collateral, including but not limited to project sheets, resumes, presentation slides, and other marketing materials.
  10. Prioritize and manage multiple projects simultaneously; following through on issues in a timely manner.
  11. Create simple proposals using established template formatting and clarifications, proofread submitted proposals for clarity, spelling, punctuation, grammar, and consistent presentation.
  12. Create project/program organizational charts according to personnel named by leadership team.
  13. Managing project, client, and consultant data in firm-wide databases.
  14. Participate in post-award debriefings and revise proposal strategies as appropriate.
  15. Assist the marketing team with other projects as needed.
  16. Request Certificate Of Insurance (COI).

  1. Create and update presentation folders, working with in-house designer for content, and manage the printing and distribution.
  2. Exemplify exceptional proofreading skills by exhibiting attention to detail, knowledge of correct spelling, grammar, and punctuation.
  3. Organize all technical marketing communications material according to set standards regarding order, clarity, conciseness, style, formatting, and terminology.
  4. Maintain events planning spreadsheet, register attendees, provide hard-copy bound printouts of presentation deck, and ship/materials/giveaways.
  5. Responsible for organizing all technical material and completing writing assignments according to set standards regarding order, clarity, conciseness, style, and terminology. Assisting with the formatting, reproduction, and distribution of technical material.
