title: Engineering Manager, Authentication Platform
description:
Are you ready to shape the future of authentication? Join 1Kosmos and help lead the next wave in identity assurance and passwordless innovation.

1Kosmos is driving the future of identity security, empowering organizations to eliminate passwords and establish trust at every step of the identity lifecycle. As a vibrant team of innovators, we develop advanced authentication solutions trusted by some of the world’s leading brands. Join us as we create a passwordless world and set new standards for digital identity assurance.

Your Title: Engineering Manager, Authentication Platform

Your Location: Hybrid – Edison, NJ HQ

You Report to: SVP of Engineering and Chief Architect

Compensation: $180,000 or more depending upon experience

At 1Kosmos, we are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead technical execution across our Authentication (Auth) Platform, the passwordless, phishing-resistant authentication, SSO, and access services that sit in the login path for millions of users. This is for someone who stays close to the code, brings sound technical judgment, and turns product requirements into secure, highly available, and shippable solutions.

You will guide a distributed team of 4-6 engineers based in India while working closely with Product and the Head of Engineering from our Edison office. This is a hands-on technical leadership role: you will set architectural direction, make design decisions, remove delivery blockers, uphold release quality, and step into the codebase when the team or situation calls for it.

You bring an “always sleeveless” mindset: no issue is too small to investigate, no production incident is beneath you, and no architectural decision should be made without understanding the system that exists today.

What you will do:

  • Steer architecture and design: Understand the existing Auth Platform deeply — authentication flows, identity federation, session and token services, and integrations and guide the team toward technically sound designs that align with current capabilities and the longer-term architectural direction.
  • Turn product needs into executable engineering work: Partner with Product early to shape requirements, clarify trade-off s, sequence work, and translate feature requests into practical, well-defined engineering plans.
  • Own Auth Platform delivery: Keep incoming work organized, priorities clear, dependencies visible, and commitments on track across passwordless login, MFA, SSO, and customer integrations.
  • Lead through technical credibility: Participate actively in design discussions, code reviews, debugging, and technical problem-solving. Step into the codebase and contribute directly when needed to validate an approach, unblock a critical effort, or resolve a production issue.
  • Set the release-quality bar: Establish and uphold standards for design review, code quality, test readiness, performance, security, standards compliance, and release decisions.
  • Own production outcomes: Authentication is in the critical path of every user session. Participate directly in incident response, troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions for Auth services, with a focus on availability and login latency.
  • Build secure, reliable systems: Drive sound engineering decisions across Node.js microservices, identity protocols, cloud-based SaaS deployments, Kubernetes, AWS, observability, performance, and platform resilience.
  • Guide and unblock the team: Provide daily technical direction, remove obstacles, facilitate effective delivery discussions, and help engineers make good decisions without becoming a status only manager.
  • Bring a point of view: Make timely, well-reasoned technical decisions amid ambiguity, clearly communicate trade-offs, and constructively challenge approaches when needed.
  • Foster collaborative execution: Work closely with Product, QA, Security, and engineering peers to create a low-ego environment where ownership, rigor, and delivery matter.

What you bring:

  • 10+ years of software engineering experience, including recent experience guiding technical delivery and engineering teams in a hands-on capacity.
  • Identity and access management depth: Experience building or operating authentication, SSO, or IAM platforms in production.
  • Proven hands-on technical leadership: Able to lead by example through architecture, code reviews, debugging, technical decision-making, and direct contribution when a critical need arises.
  • Sound technical judgment: You form an informed point of view, explain trade-offs clearly, and make decisions when the answer is not obvious.
  • Demonstrated delivery leadership: Experience organizing engineering work, identifying dependencies and risks, unblocking teams, and delivering quality capabilities predictably.
  • Strong quality and operational rigor: Experience with design and code reviews, automated testing, observability, incident response, root-cause analysis, and release readiness for high availability services.
  • Security-first mindset: Practical understanding of secure software development, threat modeling, data boundaries, platform security, and performance considerations in enterprise SaaS.
  • Collaborative technical leadership: Ability to influence through technical depth, clarity, and follow through while working effectively across US and India-based teams.
  • Willingness to work from Edison, NJ three days per week and maintain meaningful working overlap with the India-based Auth engineering team.

Technical Skills:

  • Programming Stack: Node.js / JavaScript / TypeScript - Deep, practical experience building, debugging, reviewing, and supporting production Node.js services. Node.js is the primary language across our microservices environment.
  • Java and Go: Working knowledge of Java and Go is secondary but not mandatory.
  • Identity protocols and standards: Strong working knowledge of OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, and SAML 2.0; FIDO2 / WebAuthn and passkeys; JWT and token lifecycle management (issuance, refresh, revocation); and NIST 800-63B authenticator assurance levels.
  • Authentication and access: Experience with passwordless and multi-factor authentication, session management, adaptive / risk-based authentication, and authorization models (RBAC/ABAC).

title: Senior Mechanical Inspector (Local)
location: Vung Tau, Ba Ria – Vung Tau, VN
description:
Job Description

Senior Mechanical Inspector (Local only)

Location: Vung Tau, Vietnam
Business Unit: Industry & Facilities (I&F) / Oil & Gas / Industrial Projects
Company: Bureau Veritas Vietnam

About Bureau Veritas

Bureau Veritas is a global leader in Testing, Inspection, and Certification (TIC) services. We help clients improve performance, manage risks, and ensure compliance with quality, health & safety, environmental, and social responsibility standards.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Mechanical Inspector to support inspection activities for oil & gas, petrochemical, energy, infrastructure, and industrial construction projects in Vietnam.

Position Summary

The Senior Mechanical Inspector will be responsible for conducting and coordinating inspection activities related to mechanical equipment, structural steel, welding, piping systems, fabrication, construction, and installation works. The role requires extensive field experience, strong technical knowledge of international codes and standards, and the ability to interface effectively with clients, contractors, and project stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

Mechanical Inspection

  • Perform inspections of static and rotating equipment, pressure vessels, heat exchangers, tanks, skids, packaged equipment, and associated mechanical systems.
  • Review fabrication, assembly, installation, testing, and commissioning activities for compliance with project specifications and applicable standards.
  • Witness mechanical testing, inspections, and performance verification activities.

Welding Inspection

  • Conduct welding inspections during fabrication and construction phases.
  • Verify weld procedures (WPS/PQR), welder qualifications, and welding consumables.
  • Monitor welding activities and ensure compliance with approved procedures and international codes.
  • Review NDT reports and coordinate with NDT personnel as required.

Piping Inspection

  • Inspect fabrication, erection, installation, hydrostatic testing, pneumatic testing, flushing, and reinstatement of piping systems.
  • Verify piping materials, dimensions, fit-up, supports, and installation practices.
  • Witness pressure testing and system turnover activities.

Structural Inspection

  • Conduct inspection of structural steel fabrication and erection works.
  • Verify dimensional accuracy, material traceability, bolt installation, coating preparation, and structural integrity.
  • Ensure compliance with project specifications and applicable construction standards.

Quality Assurance & Reporting

  • Prepare inspection reports, surveillance reports, non-conformance reports (NCRs), punch lists, and technical observations.
  • Maintain accurate records of inspection activities and project documentation.
  • Review ITPs, quality plans, procedures, drawings, and technical documents.
  • Identify quality issues and recommend corrective actions.

HSE Compliance

  • Promote and maintain a strong safety culture.
  • Ensure inspection activities are conducted in accordance with HSE requirements and client procedures.
  • Participate in toolbox meetings, safety observations, and site audits as required.

Client & Stakeholder Management

  • Liaise with clients, contractors, vendors, and project teams.
  • Attend inspection meetings and provide technical recommendations.
  • Represent Bureau Veritas professionally at fabrication yards, workshops, and project sites.

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Mechanical Engineering, Metallurgical Engineering, Welding Engineering, or a related discipline.

Experience

  • Minimum 10 years of experience in mechanical inspection within oil & gas, petrochemical, refinery, power, offshore, marine, or industrial projects.
  • Proven experience in:
    • Mechanical equipment inspection
    • Welding inspection
    • Structural steel inspection
    • Piping inspection
    • Fabrication yard and construction site inspections
  • Experience working with EPC contractors, fabrication yards, inspection companies, or international projects is highly preferred.

title: (CAN) Overnight Assistant Manager
description:
Position Summary...

To support the Store Manager and manage store operations according to Company guidelines and lead Associates to ensure friendly, helpful service and drive profitable store sales.

What you'll do...

1. As a member of the Store Management Team drives profitable sales through achievement of sales and profit goals, budget management and sales forecasts. Proactively analyzes and utilizes sales/financial reports, economic trends and community needs to identify and respond to market changes while controlling expenditures. Communicates sales results associates and guides interpretation of results.


2. Creates, with the balance of the Management Team, operational plans; prioritizes, delegates and provides clear direction to Managers and Associates. Ensures optimal store conditions through effective merchandise presentation, accurate and competitive pricing and store standards within Company policies and guidelines. Implements new store programs according to Company direction, while evaluating effectiveness to achieve successful results specifically related to the (Front End or Back End or Fresh or Operations - specific area that the incumbent will oversee). An Assistant Manager is cross-trained to work proficiently in all areas of the Store when needed.


3. Executes and monitors asset protection and safety controls; maintains quality assurance standards; oversees safety and operational reviews while ensuring compliance with Walmart policies and procedures and with established safety, security, sales, financial and record keeping procedures and practices. Anticipates and proactively responds to compliance issues, including Total Loss/general controls.


4. Serves Customers as an ambassador for their store by greeting customers, seeking their feedback and ensuring customer needs, complaints, and issues are resolved within Company guidelines to create a positive shopping experience. As a member of management, models, enforces, and provides direction to associates on friendly and helpful customer service approaches and techniques.


5. Supports store initiatives to serve the community by participating in and supporting community events and developing relationships with key community groups. Participates in company-sponsored programs, events, and sustainability efforts for associates and customers to emphasize the store’s role as an integral part of the community.


6. Leads Associates by conducting regular store meetings and communicating operational direction and initiatives with a focus on the OMNI and the Total Store. Drives engagement, recognizes and rewards accomplishments and provides opportunities for professional growth. Develops all associates and identifies high-potential associates, providing training and development to increase capability.


7. Demonstrates Company values by holding Associates accountable through timely, honest, specific and respectful performance feedback and corrective and disciplinary action. Builds and manages relationships with supporting functions within the store and district (e.g. District HR Managers, etc.).


8. Complies to all Company standards and procedures when handling all merchandise, including but not limited to: alcohol, ammunition, narcotics, and high-ticket. Ensures appropriate cash controls, handling as much as two hundred and fifty thousand dollar per day.

description:
Position Summary...

As a Stockperson / Cartpusher, you play an important role in creating a safe, organized, and welcoming shopping experience for customers. You are responsible for collecting shopping carts from cart corrals, the parking lot, and the store perimeter and returning them to designated storage locations using approved procedures. WHAT YOU'LL DO

Support Customer Service Operations
Collect shopping carts from cart corrals, the parking lot, and store perimeter, and return them safely to designated storage areas using Walmart approved procedures. Ensure required logs are completed accurately.

Respond to Customer and Store Needs
Respond promptly to requests from all registers and Customer Service, including assisting customers with carry outs and carry ins and verifying receipts for proof of purchase when required.

Maintain Clean Facilities and Equipment
Perform occasional cleaning and maintenance duties, including restrooms, while following established guidelines for chemical handling, proper disposal procedures, and safe use of power equipment. Complete required equipment inspections before use.

Follow Safety Standards and Procedures
Adhere to all safety and emergency protocols, including hazardous communication, lockout/tagout, and bloodborne pathogen guidelines, to maintain a safe environment for customers and associates.

• Be open to working a variety of shifts, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, based on business needs. Your adaptability helps ensure the store runs smoothly and customers receive consistent, high-quality service.

POTENTIAL CHALLENGES IN THIS ROLE

High Task Volume in a Fast-Paced Environment
• Manages overnight hours effectively and planning accordingly to stay energized and focused.
• Effectively manages work hours and plans ahead to maintain energy and focus throughout the shift.
• Handles a fast-paced workload with efficiency, ensuring large volumes of restocking and recovery are completed accurately and on time.

Physical Demands
• Performs physical tasks such as standing for extended periods, bending, and lifting inventory, equipment, or supplies weighing up to 20 lbs., and occasionally up to 50 lbs.
• Performs repetitive tasks such as stocking, zoning, and organizing products with attention to detail and consistency to uphold store standards.

title: Senior Manager, Sourcing - IF-2
description:
Position Summary...

This role executes Private Brand sourcing strategies for assigned categories, including direct imports for Private Brand and National Brand items, maximizing margin and profitable sales.

What you'll do...

This role develops complex sourcing strategies for assigned products by collaborating with cross-functional business partners to understand product demand. It serves as a subject-matter and industry expert for multiple commodities and items, overseeing sourcing programs at the item level, and influencing business partners to bring product and packaging innovation to market.

The role aligns the sourcing strategy with the annual operating plan of merchants, providing perishability and quality insights to guide merchandise flow and replenishment decisions. It incorporates company growth strategies into planning, such as growth in direct imports.

This role creates complex vendor decision matrices by evaluating new and existing vendors based on performance metrics and long-term potential. It negotiates with vendors to obtain products at the lowest sustainable costs, tracking awarded costs against actual costs and ensuring cost keys are accurate. It informs planners and merchants of changes that affect the cost of goods.

Developing strategic vendor relationships with multi-year contracts for business continuity is part of this role. It identifies, develops, and maintains supplier relationships that meet company financial, ethical, and sustainability standards. The role assesses and develops vendor capabilities, conducts quarterly performance reviews, and resolves vendor issues.

Additionally, this role drives execution of business plans and projects, removing barriers, providing resources, and developing contingency plans. It ensures associates receive supervision and development opportunities, promotes company policies and values, and evaluates the effectiveness of current plans, programs, and initiatives. The role also supports community outreach events.

You’ll sweep us off our feet if...

  • You enjoy owning and developing plans for highly complex category strategy, supporting long term business plans and executing prioritized strategic initiatives.
  • You are omni channel customer focused: You make member-centric recommendations and decisions across all member touchpoints. Constantly incorporate applicable and actionable feedback. Understand customer behavior across channels, or within relevant channels. Guide suppliers and vendors in the development of customer focused processes and products.
  • You are tenacious, dedicated and thrive working with ownership, autonomy, and a healthy dose of competition.
  • You develop and leverage internal and external partnerships and networks to maximize the achievement of business goals by sponsoring and leading key community outreach and involvement initiatives; engaging key stakeholders in the development, execution, and evaluation of appropriate business plans and initiatives; and supporting associate efforts in these areas.

Leadership Expectations:

Respect the Individual:

Demonstrates and encourages respect for others; drives a positive associate and customer experience for all; embraces differences in people, cultures, ideas, and experiences; supports workplaces where associated feel seen and connected through a culture of belonging, so all associates thrive and perform; contributes to an environment allowing everyone to bring their best selves to work.

Demonstrates engagement and commitment to the team, developing others through feedback, coaching, mentoring, and developmental opportunities; and recognizes others’ contributions and accomplishments.

Builds strong and trusting relationships with team members and business partners; works collaboratively to achieve objectives; communicates with impact and listens attentively to a range of audiences; and demonstrates energy and positivity for own work.

Acts with Integrity:

Maintains and promotes the highest standards of integrity, ethics and compliance; models the Walmart values and leads by example to foster our culture; supports Walmart’s goal of becoming a regenerative company by making a positive impact for associates, customers, and the world around us (e.g., creating a sense of belonging, eliminating waste, participating in local giving).

Follows the law, our code of conduct and company policies, and encourages others to do the same; supports an environment where associates feel comfortable sharing concerns; reinforces our culture of non-retaliation; listens to concerns raised by associates and takes action; acts with accountability for achieving results in a way that is consistent with our values.

Is consistently humble, self-aware, honest, and transparent.

Serve our Customers:

Delivers results while putting the customer first and applying an omni-merchant mindset and acts with an Every Day Low Cost mindset to drive value and Every Day Low Prices for customers.

Adopts a broad perspective that considers data, analytics, customer insights, and different parts of the business when making plans.

Strive for Excellence:

Consistently raises the bar and seeks to improve; demonstrates curiosity and a growth mindset; seeks feedback, asks thoughtful questions; supports innovation and intelligent risk-taking; and exhibits resilience in the face of setbacks.

Implements and supports continuous improvements and willingly embraces new digital tools and ways of working.

title: Pharmacy Assistant
description:
Position Summary...

The Pharmacy Assistant assists the Pharmacist in the technical aspects of prescription filling and administrative duties in order to increase the Pharmacist's opportunity to provide patient care. The Pharmacy Assistant is expected to participate in all aspects of Pharmacy Operations required of a team player. They are a key member in the delivery of superior customer service.

What you'll do...

1. Receiving prescriptions from patients, following provincial legal/regulatory conditions and assessing the prescription for completeness i.e. Name; Address; DOB; Allergies; 3rd Party Information; Any Special Requests; Prescriber; Generic/Brand; Prioritizing Prescriptions with 21st Century Guidelines.
2. Performing Computer Functions as directed by the Pharmacist i.e. Data Entry; Price Check; Patient Information Entry/Update; Competent interpretation and processing of written prescriptions including Latin abbreviations, drug name recognition, dosage calculations; Refills; Report Generation; Patient Profile checks.
3. Filling prescriptions (always under the Pharmacist’s supervision), selecting appropriate products, performing the accuracy program, including 7 point, Visual and DIN checks, selecting and counting/ measuring & preparing appropriate products, labeling and organizing for pharmacist checking, gaining necessary approvals for verbal refills where authorized, employing 'STOP' forms if applicable and facilitating all aspects of Cognitive Services.
4. Maintaining Inventory Control, assisting Pharmacist in maintaining appropriate stock levels of drugs and supplies, checking for and pulling expired medications at least monthly, cleaning up Will Call Bin of 'stale' prescriptions on a regular basis, writing up returns, ordering of drugs and supplies, using preferred wholesaler for Pharmacy purchases as much as possible i.e. Kohl and Frisch, operating of the Telxon gun, checking off, pricing and putting away pharmacy orders, zoning the pharmacy shelves, 'X- ing' bottles when opened and interchangeable drug knowledge and appropriate maintenance/selection of key brands/preferred generics.
5. General Housekeeping, stocking Prescription filling supplies (Vials, labels, bags), keeping the dispensary clean, organized and neat, maintaining clean/safe work environment as part of the team approach (i.e. dishes, garbage) and maintaining & cleaning packaging & dispensing equipment, computer, fax machine, etc.
6. Clerical Organization, filing prescriptions, invoices, reports, correspondence and memos and completing any administrative support functions assigned (i.e. journals, accounts receivable, Aged Trial Balance).
7. Assisting with OTC Operations and ordering, stocking, cashier duties as assigned by OTC Manager and/or Pharmacist.

The pay range for this position is $20.15 - $26.42/hr. Rate of pay will be determined based on relevant experience.

title: Expert, Brand Experience and Identity
description:
Job Purpose

  • Developing and managing offline brand assets and physical brand touchpoints to ensure a consistent and premium Techcombank brand experience across customer journeys.
  • Leads the development, implementation, and governance of offline branding initiatives, ensuring alignment with the Bank's brand strategy, brand identity standards, customer insights, and business objectives.
  • Collaborates with internal stakeholders and external partners to strengthen brand visibility, emotional connection, brand love and overall brand equity through impactful offline brand experiences.

Key Accountabilities

1. Offline Brand Asset Development & Management

  • Develop and implement offline brand assets that enhance customer experience and strengthen brand perception, including:

    • Customer gifts and loyalty gifts.

    • Branding kits and merchandise.

    • Seasonal and special publications (Tet calendars, red envelopes, premium gift collections, etc.).

    • POSM materials supporting campaigns and business initiatives.

    • Uniforms and other branded materials.

  • Ensure all brand assets are aligned with Techcombank's brand positioning, customer insights, campaign objectives, and brand identity standards.

  • Manage the end-to-end development process of offline brand assets from concept development, design, production, procurement to deployment.

2. Physical Brand Touchpoint Development

  • Lead the implementation and enhancement of Techcombank's brand identity across physical customer touchpoints, including:

    • Branches and transaction offices.

    • Office buildings and workplaces.

    • Events, activations and experiential marketing programs.

    • Special occasions such as Tet holidays, Techcombank anniversaries, major campaigns and brand-led initiatives.

  • Ensure seamless integration between online and offline brand experiences, translating campaign concepts into impactful physical experiences.

  • Work closely with business units, operation teams, facilities management, procurement and vendors to ensure consistency and quality execution.

3. Brand Identity Governance

  • Develop, update and standardize brand identity guidelines applicable to offline assets and physical environments.

  • Establish governance mechanisms and quality control processes to ensure compliance with Techcombank brand standards across all offline materials and touchpoints.

  • Conduct regular audits and reviews of offline branding implementation to identify improvement opportunities and ensure consistency nationwide.

  • Provide consultation and guidance to internal stakeholders on offline branding standards and applications.

4. Stakeholder & Vendor Management

  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders including Marketing, Retail Banking, Wealth Management, Human Resources, Administration and Operations teams to execute branding initiatives.

  • Manage relationships with creative agencies, production houses, printing vendors and other suppliers to ensure quality, timeline and cost effectiveness.

  • Monitor project progress, budget utilization and implementation effectiveness.

5. Reporting & Performance Evaluation

  • Track and evaluate the effectiveness of offline branding initiatives.

  • Prepare and present reports on project progress, implementation results, budget performance and opportunities for improvement.

  • Recommend innovative solutions and best practices to continuously enhance customer experience and brand visibility.

6. Other duties as assigned.

Success Profile - Qualification and Experiences

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree or above in Marketing, Brand Management, Business Administration, Communications, Design, Advertising or related disciplines

Expertise

  • Strong expertise in Brand Management, Brand Identity Development and Brand Experience Management.
  • Solid understanding of customer experience design and omnichannel branding.
  • Knowledge of merchandising development, production management and offline marketing execution.
  • Strong project management and stakeholder management capabilities.
  • Experience in managing large-scale branding projects and multiple vendors simultaneously.
  • Ability to balance brand vision, business objectives and operational feasibility.

Work Experience

  • Minimum 6 years of experience in Brand Management, Brand Development, Marketing Communications or related fields.
  • Proven experience in managing offline brand assets, physical branding environments and customer experience initiatives.
  • Experience working in Banking, Financial Services, FMCG, Retail or multinational organizations is preferred.
  • At least 2 years of experience in leading project teams, cross-functional initiatives or managing external agencies/vendors.

title: Senior Staff Security Engineer (Copy)
description:
The opportunity ahead
Spotnana is seeking an experienced Senior Manager, Security Engineering to lead the Security Engineering team in our global Security organization. You will run Security Engineering for Spotnana's travel platform and corporate systems and you will build a team of security engineers who make security part of how Spotnana builds software. Security at Spotnana advises Engineering and does not manage it, so you will win agreement from Engineering leaders through clear risk analysis and practical solutions. The ideal candidate is a hands-on leader who reviews designs and code, hires and develops strong engineers, and turns security strategy into a quarterly plan that the team delivers. You will report to the Head of Security & IT.

How you'll help us build
  • Hire, develop, and manage a team of security engineers across application, cloud, and infrastructure security
  • Own the Security Engineering plan for the current and next quarter, based on the Security strategy
  • Own the secure software development lifecycle (SDLC) program and its standards across all Engineering teams
  • Run the security design review process for new features, partner APIs, payment flows, and AI features, and align review SLAs with the rest of the business
  • Set the fix priority for security findings, with the risk to traveler, payment, and customer data as the main input, and escalate overdue critical findings
  • Align security priorities with the business and development teams and keep them on the roadmap
  • Own the SDLC, change management, and cloud configuration controls in PCI DSS, SOC 2, and ISO 27001 audits, with the GRC team
  • Manage the annual external penetration test and the relationships with Security Engineering tool vendors
  • Decide how the team splits its time between projects, design reviews, and findings
  • Propose headcount, tool, and vendor spend for the team in the annual budget
  • Report team metrics, such as open findings by severity and review cycle time, to Security leadership

Experience you bring
  • 10+ years of security engineering experience, with 3+ years as a manager of security engineers
  • A record of hiring, developing, and managing the performance of security engineers
  • Deep expertise in at least one of application security, cloud security (AWS), or infrastructure security, and working knowledge of the others
  • Experience with a secure SDLC program: threat models, code and dependency scans, and security checks in CI/CD pipelines
  • Ability to influence without authority and to communicate clearly to engineers, executives, and auditors
  • Experience with PCI DSS, SOC 2, or ISO 27001 audits
  • Fluency in at least one programming language, with the ability to review code and build security automation
  • Java, Golang, and Python a strong plus
  • Experience with an API-driven, multi-region SaaS platform a plus
  • Familiarity with the security risks of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning features a plus
  • Experience in travel technology or payments a plus

What to expect next
Selected candidates will participate in cross-functional virtual interviews exploring their relevant experience, approach to problem-solving, critical thinking, and alignment with Spotnana’s core values. Interviews will include face-to-face conversations as well as coding exercises to demonstrate your ability.

Work Authorization: This position is not eligible for employment-based visa sponsorship. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States and must not require current or future employment sponsorship.

Let’s talk compensation
Spotnana strives to offer fair, industry-competitive, and equitable compensation. Our total compensation package includes base salary, an annual performance bonus, company equity, and comprehensive benefits. We use trusted third-party market data to establish compensation ranges that are competitive for the role, industry, company size, and geographic market, while maintaining internal equity across our team.

Compensation is determined based on a variety of factors, including skills, experience, qualifications, and work location. The anticipated annual base salary hiring ranges for this role are:

  • New York Metro Area, San Francisco Bay Area, Seattle Metro Area: $186,900-$250,000
  • California, New Jersey, Washington, New York, Washington, D.C., Massachusetts, Connecticut: $178,800-$238,000
  • Hawaii, Alaska, Maryland, Illinois, New Hampshire, Oregon, Colorado, Virginia, Delaware, Minnesota, Rhode Island, Pennsylvania, Texas: $170,700-$226,000
  • All other U.S. states: $162,600-$214,000

Actual compensation may vary based on individual qualifications and the applicable geographic market.
We care for the people who make everything possible - our benefits offerings include:
  • Equity in the form of stock options, which provides partial ownership in the company, so you can share in the success of the company as it grows
  • Pre-tax and ROTH 401(k) options via Fidelity with up to a 4% company match
  • Comprehensive benefit plans covering medical, dental, vision, life, and disability effective on your hire date. We cover 100% of your employee premiums and 85% of your eligible dependents
  • Pre-tax flexible spending account options for health, dependent care, and commuter expenses
  • Flexible PTO in addition to 10 company holidays and an end-of-year company shutdown
  • Up to 26 weeks of Parental Leave
  • Monthly cell phone/internet stipend
  • Extra perks — IATAN travel membership, pet insurance, financial wellness tools, Calm app access, and more

title: Senior Contracted Clinician - GP Trainer
description:
At Bupa, purpose meets possible. Join us and help shape a future where healthcare is more connected, more personal and more human.


We’re a global healthcare leader trusted by millions and committed to helping people to live longer, healthier, happier lives and making a better world. Healthcare is changing, and so are we. We’re investing in more clinics, better systems and smarter, more connected ways to help our customers. As we continue to expand our services and invest in innovation, you’ll help create a healthcare system that meets people where they are, responds to what they need and leaves them better than before.


Here, your work has purpose, your voice matters and your future is full of possibility

You might think you already know a lot about Bupa. You’ll know we provide health insurance and aged care services across Australia and you’ve probably also seen our dental and optical clinics in your local shopping centres. But what you might not realise is that Bupa supports health services to 85,000 Defence Force members and their families across more than 50 locations in Australia.


HMAS Cairns’ primary responsibility is to provide maintenance, logistic and administrative support for Cairns based Fleet Units. HMAS Cairns also provides refit and training support for neighbouring Pacific Island nations and is located the city of Cairns in Queensland delivers a range of health services to Defence personnel. It’s a busy, vibrant, and unique clinical environment offering a variety of clinical challenges as well as leadership and continuous improvement opportunities.


About the role

This role is on base at the Health Centre at HMAS Cairns. Part Time Tuesday - Thursday


Our Senior Clinician is a civilian GP and GP Supervisor and a senior member of the management team within the region. Balancing both clinical and administrative responsibilities across the Cairns Health Centre, you will be responsible for:



  • Providing information, advice, and recommendations on medical issues and specialist medical services to the Health Centre manager
  • General Practice consultations, referrals, health screenings and liaison with allied health professionals
  • Provision of occupational health services and preventative health care
  • Participating in quality and governance improvement including, giving subject matter expertise advice to clinical incident and complaints management and performance management processes
  • Providing workforce advice and support including adequate staffing levels within department and supervision of clinical staff
  • Conducting team meetings and staff training activities
  • Managing the delivery of services against benchmark standards and other clinical governance Key Performance Indicators


This is an incredible role for clinician with a focus on mentorship, clinical leadership and continuous improvement to join our Health Centre and make a real contribution to the provision of health services to our defence force members.


About you


Please note: You must be an Australian citizen and be able to attain and maintain a baseline security clearance from the Defence security and vetting service.


We’re looking for someone who:


  • has excellent interpersonal and communication skills
  • works well with both people and details – this role involves interactions with both clinical and non-clinical team members as well as working with lots of legislative frameworks, nuanced processes and compliance activity - so you’ll need to be great at both
  • has strong management skills including leadership, conflict resolution and an understanding of medical ethics and medico legal issues
  • Has a genuine commitment to mentor, lead and grow internal talent and champion a meaningful career pathway for our clinicians


You will also require:

  • Current unconditional and unrestricted registration as a medical practitioner in Australia with AHPRA
  • A Fellowship of the Royal Australian College of General Practitioners (FRACGP), Fellowship of the Australian College of Rural and Remote Medicine (FACRRM) or Vocational Registration
  • Accreditation as a General Practice Trainer at Principal/Lead Supervisor level or commitment to achieving his accreditation.
  • Post Graduate Qualifications in Health Management (Graduate Certificate, Graduate Diploma, Masters, PhD or Doctorate) or commitment to working toward same (Bupa supported fees!)


Be at the heart of it with Bupa:


The Cairns Health Centre team are passionate and professional, and really care about the work we do. We’re operating in a unique clinical environment with extremely high standards, compliance, and contractual obligations. We’re known for being driven and responsive to the needs of the ADF members, with ADF members at the centre of everything we do.


This is your opportunity to make a real impact on our services to help shape the health outcomes of people serving in the Australian Defence Forces.


We will be shortlisting and interviewing over the next few weeks so please apply as soon as possible

title: Contracts Coordinator (MA4/DBHR)
description:
Description

Contracts Coordinator (Management Analyst 4)

This is a full-time, permanent, remote position. Employees may occasionally be asked to attend an in-person meeting or event based on business needs.

All HCA employees are required to be Washington state residents upon their first day of employment.

The Opportunity

Bring structure and strategy to a large, high-impact contracting portfolio. The Division of Behavioral Health and Recovery (DBHR) is seeking a Contracts Coordinator to serve as the division’s subject matter expert for contracts and federal grants submissions. Working in DBHR’s Operations section, you will lead contract coordination across the division, manage large umbrella contracts, train contract managers, and partner with HCA’s Office of Contracts and Procurement (OCP), the Office of Tribal Affairs, and other divisions to keep work on track and minimize the risk of audit findings.

Key Responsibilities:

  • The DBHR Contract Coordinator plans, leads, and strategically manages the contracting of DBHR by ensuring all contracts and procurements are tracked and there is agreed scope, procurement method, and timeline between DBHR and HCA programs/central services (finance, legal, OCP, DATA, Office of Tribal Affairs (OTA), etc.)
  • Be responsible for timely escalation of issues and risks to DBHR leaders and OCP assigned points of contact to coordinate legal review and resolution of matters prior to escalating the issue or risk to agency leadership. This requires use of sound judgement, expert level organizational agility, and good communication skills.
  • Act as a key liaison to shared services divisions within HCA for the administration of DBHR contracts and procurements.
  • Utilize strong organizational and communication skills to facilitate, and coordinate, large-scale, multifaceted, highly political, confidential, and time sensitive contracts, and interagency umbrella agreements, at times supporting external contractors in the workplace at HCA and all relevant policies and procedures.
  • Serve as backup contract manager for all DBHR contracts and be listed as such in documentation to ensure there is always a backup on contracts and track and be notified of contract completion dates across the division, serve as backup communication on contracts when a contract manager is out or has transitioned.
  • Plan, leads, manages, and directs DBHR contract managers and their own contracts working closely with OCP contracting/procurement professionals and project managers in accordance with Department of Enterprise Services (DES) and HCA procurement, contracting, and purchasing policies and procedures.
  • Conduct independent, comprehensive analyses of reports and work products submitted by contractors; establish and maintain systems of communication and tracking.

Why You’ll Love This Role:

  • You’ll be the go-to contract contracts expert for one of HCA’s largest divisions, supporting behavioral health services across Washington.
  • You’ll work on complex, high-visibility projects with leaders across HCA and partner agencies.
  • You’ll share your expertise by training contract managers and shaping division-wide processes.
  • You’ll work remotely, with occasional travel as business needs require.

What You Bring:

You are a highly organized, detail-oriented professional who enjoys bringing structure to complex work. You use sound judgement to spot risks early and know when to escalate them. You communicate clearly, negotiate effectively, and build strong partnerships with colleagues at every level, from line staff to senior leaders. You handle confidential and politically sensitive matters with discretion, manage multiple projects independently, and enjoy helping others build their skills.

Required Qualifications

Experience may have been gained through paid or unpaid activities. Please ensure any relevant experience defined below is outlined in your cover letter, resume, and application.

  • Advanced Research and Analytical Thinking- Demonstrated expertise in conducting and leading complex research and analysis involving multiple programs, business functions, data sources, and competing considerations to develop actionable recommendations.
  • Business Process and Program Improvement- Demonstrated ability to lead evaluations of complex programs, business processes, organizational structures, and workflows to identify and implement solutions that improve efficiency, effectiveness, accountability, and service delivery.
  • Policy and Organizational Impact Analysis- Demonstrated knowledge of analytical methods used to interpret complex laws, rules, policies, standards, and organizational requirements and assess their operational, programmatic, and organizational impacts.
  • Advanced Data Analysis and Performance Management- Demonstrated proficiency in integrating and evaluating quantitative and qualitative information from multiple sources, developing meaningful performance measures, assessing organizational effectiveness, and recommending improvements.
  • Complex Project and Initiative Leadership- Demonstrated ability to lead complex projects and organizational initiatives involving multiple stakeholders, competing priorities, significant dependencies, and broad organizational impacts.
  • Management Consultation and Communication- Demonstrated expertise in providing consultation to managers and senior leaders on complex analytical issues and effectively communicating findings, risks, alternatives, and recommendations to technical and nontechnical audiences.
  • Leadership and Stakeholder Facilitation- Demonstrated skill in leading collaborative analytical efforts, facilitating diverse stakeholder groups, resolving competing perspectives, building consensus, and providing technical guidance to analysts and staff.

Required Competencies:

Equity lens – All HCA employees are required to consider equity in their decisions, processes, and day-to-day work, including how their work may affect the people and communities we serve.

The ability to take action to learn and grow – You take action to learn and grow by seeking new perspectives, learning from experiences, and using what you’ve learned to continuously improve how you work and serve others.

The ability to take action to meet the needs of others – You take action to meet the needs of others by listening, understanding different perspectives, and responding with care, respect, and solutions that support the people of the communities we serve.

Preferred Qualifications

While these are not required, having them may help you stand out as an applicant.

  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, public administration, law, public health, health administration, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated skill in organizing work, coordinating activities, managing competing priorities, and meeting established deadlines to support efficient and effective operations.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate across organizational boundaries, build and train effective teams, evaluate existing programs and processes, and implement improvements that enhance operational effectiveness.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in independently managing multiple activities and projects from initiation through completion, establishing priorities, exercising sound judgment, and making informed decisions with limited supervision.
  • Superior communication and interpersonal skills and professionalism, especially the ability to communicate, negotiate, listen, and partner with a variety of individuals and groups internal and external to HCA.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence, develop, and improve complex systems and business processes while effectively addressing multiple competing organizational priorities.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of grant administration or medical contracting principles, practices, and requirements, including project management methods and processes.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in utilizing software applications, analytical tools, and data analysis techniques to extract, evaluate, interpret, and communicate information from multiple systems.

About the Division of Behavioral Health and Recovery (DBHR)

DBHR provides support for substance use treatment, mental health services, and problem gambling services through prevention, treatment, peer, and recovery support. Programs promote strategies that support healthy lifestyles by preventing the misuse of alcohol, tobacco, and other drugs, supporting recovery from substance use, promoting recovery and resiliency, reducing stigma, and mitigating the effects of problem gambling on the individual and family. DBHR brings operational elements such as substance use and mental health into closer working relations to serve individuals more effectively and efficiently. The DBHR Contracts Coordinator is located within the Operations Team, a section with Division of Behavioral Health and Recovery. description:
Position Summary...

Job Description Summary
The Manager, Project and Construction will have a specialty in overseeing and coordinating HVAC and Refrigeration construction and facility projects, ensuring timely and budget-compliant delivery while adhering to industry, regulatory, and company standards. They will also support in managing and coordinating other facility categorized projects as needed. This role significantly contributes to the company's growth through expertise in commercial HVAC and refrigeration practices and environmental standards.

What you'll do...

Job Description

The Manager, Project and Construction Manages large-scale, cross-functional maintenance programs, including capital projects, facility retrofits, and energy-efficiency initiatives. Collaborates with internal stakeholders and external service providers to ensure projects are delivered safely, on time, and within budget. Monitors project schedules, milestones, resource allocation, and financial performance to ensure alignment with organizational priorities and operational objectives.


Provides leadership and direction to a team of Managers and Supervisors by delivering coaching, performance feedback, and development opportunities. Builds and sustains a high-performing, safety-focused maintenance organization through strategic workforce planning, technical training, and succession planning. Fosters a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and operational excellence by establishing clear performance expectations and conducting regular performance evaluations.


Develops and manages regional project budgets, including labor, materials, operating expenses, and capital expenditures. Evaluates the return on investment of maintenance initiatives and identifies cost reduction opportunities through vendor management, process improvements, and operational efficiencies. Ensures accurate forecasting, financial reporting, and budget control. Maintains compliance with company policies by reviewing and approving corporate card transactions, associate time records, and expenditures to verify alignment with approved scopes of work and budgetary guidelines.


Ensures compliance with all applicable federal, provincial/state, and local regulations, including refrigerant management, mechanical licensing, and environmental requirements. Conducts audits and inspections to identify and mitigate operational risks, including vehicle safety audits, inventory verification, equipment condition assessments, work order documentation reviews, and adherence to operational standards. Partners closely with Safety and Compliance teams to maintain regulatory compliance and uphold company standards.


Drives the execution of strategic business plans and maintenance initiatives by identifying operational needs, establishing priorities, allocating resources, and removing barriers to performance. Develops and communicates actionable plans, defines performance metrics, measures progress, and implements corrective actions as needed. Demonstrates adaptability, supports continuous learning, and develops contingency plans to ensure sustained operational effectiveness and business continuity.

Leadership Expectations:

Respect the Individual:

Demonstrates and encourages respect for others; drives a positive associate and customer experience for all; embraces differences in people, cultures, ideas, and experiences; supports workplaces where associated feel seen and connected through a culture of belonging, so all associates thrive and perform; contributes to an environment allowing everyone to bring their best selves to work.

Demonstrates engagement and commitment to the team, developing others through feedback, coaching, mentoring, and developmental opportunities; and recognizes others’ contributions and accomplishments.

Builds strong and trusting relationships with team members and business partners; works collaboratively to achieve objectives; communicates with impact and listens attentively to a range of audiences; and demonstrates energy and positivity for own work.

Acts with Integrity:

Maintains and promotes the highest standards of integrity, ethics and compliance; models the Walmart values and leads by example to foster our culture; supports Walmart’s goal of becoming a regenerative company by making a positive impact for associates, customers, and the world around us (e.g., creating a sense of belonging, eliminating waste, participating in local giving).

Follows the law, our code of conduct and company policies, and encourages others to do the same; supports an environment where associates feel comfortable sharing concerns; reinforces our culture of non-retaliation; listens to concerns raised by associates and takes action; acts with accountability for achieving results in a way that is consistent with our values.

Is consistently humble, self-aware, honest, and transparent.

Serve our Customers:

Delivers results while putting the customer first and applying an omni-merchant mindset and acts with an Every Day Low Cost mindset to drive value and Every Day Low Prices for customers.

Adopts a broad perspective that considers data, analytics, customer insights, and different parts of the business when making plans.

Strive for Excellence:

Consistently raises the bar and seeks to improve; demonstrates curiosity and a growth mindset; seeks feedback, asks thoughtful questions; supports innovation and intelligent risk-taking; and exhibits resilience in the face of setbacks.

Implements and supports continuous improvements and willingly embraces new digital tools and ways of working.

description:
Be the spark that brightens days and ignite your career with TTEC’s award-winning employment experience. As a Temporary Service Delivery Manager working onsite in Cainta, Rizal, Philippines, you’ll be a part of bringing humanity to business. #experienceTTEC


What You’ll be Doing

Do you have a passion for leading, mentoring and coaching? Looking for an opportunity to learn more about the industry, gain direct management experience, and work closely with an iconic brand? In this role, you’ll support and motivate your team to make sure they’re on track to meet client goals. You’ll work to answer associate questions, issues, and customer escalation while ensuring quality customer experience on every call. You’re an instrumental part in creating and maintaining a positive work environment for your team, ensuring we meet client requests and needs and acknowledge a job well done.


You’ll report to the Senior Manager, Service Delivery. We’re looking for a leader to Act as one, as you will encourage and motivate your team to resolve issues, accomplish goals, and influence their career mobility.


During a Typical Day, You’ll

· Improve the key success metrics associated with goals. These include\:
• Customer Satisfaction Score
• Service Level Goals
• Quality Goals
· Coach associates to ensure achievement of company and client goals while addressing employee related issues and coordinating training on new or revised information relating to services, products or processes of projects
· Bring your time management and organizational skills to manage multiple, complex, on‐going tasks and projects while monitoring absence and attendance of your team


What You Bring to the Role

· Minimum 1 year lead/supervisory experience in a call center/ BPO setting
· Continuously promote a performance-driven culture and always work towards reaching for amazing
· Engage and support your team in making sure they have the proper tools and systems to accomplish day-to-day tasks
· Consistently mentor and inspire others
· Customer focused mindset
· Understanding, interpreting, and manipulating data for reporting


What You Can Expect

· Supportive of your career and professional development
· An inclusive culture and community minded organization where giving back is encouraged
· A global team of curious lifelong learners guided by our company values
· Ask us about our paid time off (PTO) and wellness and healthcare benefits
· And yes... a great compensation package and performance bonus opportunities, benefits you'd expect and maybe a few that would pleasantly surprise you (like tuition reimbursement) Visit https\://mybenefits.ttec.com/?manual for more information.

About TTEC

Our business is about making customers happy. That's all we do. Since 1982, we've helped companies build engaged, pleased, profitable customer experiences powered by our combination of humanity and technology. On behalf of many of the world's leading iconic and hypergrowth brands, we talk, message, text, and video chat with millions of customers every day. These exceptional customer experiences start with you.

TTEC is proud to be an equal opportunity employer where all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. TTEC embraces and is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce that respects and empowers the cultures and perspectives within our global teams. We aim to reflect the communities we serve, by not only delivering amazing service and technology, but also humanity. We make it a point to make sure all our employees feel valued, belonging, and comfortable being their authentic selves at work. As a global company, we know diversity is our strength because it enables us to view things from different vantage points and for you to bring value to the table in your own unique way.

description:
VACANCY: Raw Glass Co-ordinator - Shatterprufe Struandale

A vacancy exists for a Raw Glass Co-ordinator at Shatterprufe Struandale, Port Elizabeth. This is a Senior Staff position reporting to the Production Planner in the Planning and Logistics department.



Main job purpose

Effectively manage the Raw Glass team. Ordering of raw glass and ensuring its availability for production in line with customer demand so as to maximise productivity and product quality while minimising stock holding and wastage.



Main Objective

Responsible for the effective ordering of raw glass within target quantities as outlined in KPI's thereby ensuring correct quantities are ordered so as to maximise
productivity while minimising stock holding and wastage.
Responsible for the accurate recording of non-conformance due to supplier supplying incorrect materials and ensuring that corrective actions are in place for any non
conformance so as ensure that in-plant cutting losses are kept to a minimum.
Responsible for booking glass into In-Transit account from PFG in line with truck turnaround time so as to reduce financial loss for the business and to ensure the
timeous availability of glass to the factory.
Issue raw glass in accordance to FIFO, set cutting plan and customer requirements by ensuring correct mix in Plant to minimise delays to production and to reduce
waste.
Identified non-moving product and used in cases of deviation from actual size so as to move stock and avoid redundancy of product and financial loss for the business.
Responsible for 5S projects to ensure continuous improvement and improve immediate workplace.
Responsible for Safety in immediate area by ensuring 90% or higher is maintained on safety scores to minimize harm to people in the Plant.
To effectively coach and mentor identified high potential candidates in order to improve skills, support succession plans for key critical and scarce positions, drive staff
engagement and retention and ultimately increase profits through improved capability, performance and productivity.
Ensure effective communication of relevant information to all stakeholders to support decision making for the business.

Computer Skills (MS Office) Communication Skills (written and verbal)

Planned and Organised

3 years Logistics experience 2 years leadership experience

title: (CAN) Pharmacy Assistant (Part Time)
description:
Position Summary...

The Pharmacy Assistant assists the Pharmacist in the technical aspects of prescription filling and administrative duties in order to increase the Pharmacist's opportunity to provide patient care. The Pharmacy Assistant is expected to participate in all aspects of Pharmacy Operations required of a team player. They are a key member in the delivery of superior customer service.

What you'll do...

1. Receiving prescriptions from patients, following provincial legal/regulatory conditions and assessing the prescription for completeness i.e. Name; Address; DOB; Allergies; 3rd Party Information; Any Special Requests; Prescriber; Generic/Brand; Prioritizing Prescriptions with 21st Century Guidelines.
2. Performing Computer Functions as directed by the Pharmacist i.e. Data Entry; Price Check; Patient Information Entry/Update; Competent interpretation and processing of written prescriptions including Latin abbreviations, drug name recognition, dosage calculations; Refills; Report Generation; Patient Profile checks.
3. Filling prescriptions (always under the Pharmacist’s supervision), selecting appropriate products, performing the accuracy program, including 7 point, Visual and DIN checks, selecting and counting/ measuring & preparing appropriate products, labeling and organizing for pharmacist checking, gaining necessary approvals for verbal refills where authorized, employing 'STOP' forms if applicable and facilitating all aspects of Cognitive Services.
4. Maintaining Inventory Control, assisting Pharmacist in maintaining appropriate stock levels of drugs and supplies, checking for and pulling expired medications at least monthly, cleaning up Will Call Bin of 'stale' prescriptions on a regular basis, writing up returns, ordering of drugs and supplies, using preferred wholesaler for Pharmacy purchases as much as possible i.e. Kohl and Frisch, operating of the Telxon gun, checking off, pricing and putting away pharmacy orders, zoning the pharmacy shelves, 'X- ing' bottles when opened and interchangeable drug knowledge and appropriate maintenance/selection of key brands/preferred generics.
5. General Housekeeping, stocking Prescription filling supplies (Vials, labels, bags), keeping the dispensary clean, organized and neat, maintaining clean/safe work environment as part of the team approach (i.e. dishes, garbage) and maintaining & cleaning packaging & dispensing equipment, computer, fax machine, etc.
6. Clerical Organization, filing prescriptions, invoices, reports, correspondence and memos and completing any administrative support functions assigned (i.e. journals, accounts receivable, Aged Trial Balance).
7. Assisting with OTC Operations and ordering, stocking, cashier duties as assigned by OTC Manager and/or Pharmacist.

The pay range for this position is $17.60 - $23.10/hr. Rate of pay will be determined based on relevant experience.

title: Sr Program Controls Scheduler
description:
As a Sr Program Controls Scheduler here at Honeywell, you will Join a team of specialists that provide program analysis, process improvement, and metrics for Honeywell. You will partner with Integrated project team to develop project plans and create cost and schedule baselines. You will prepare and publish metrics and reports. You will analyze variances and review compliance to corporate guidelines across multiple teams. Your findings will drive decisions to improve the project/program performance impacting one or more site locations.

You will report directly to our Program Controls Manager and you’ll work out of our Houston, TX location on a Hybrid work schedule.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Create and maintain integrated program schedules using Primavera P6, MS Project, and PMIS, incorporating WBS structures, resource loading, milestone management, and Critical Path Methodology (CPM).
  • Perform schedule health assessments, schedule risk analyses, and forecasting activities to identify risks, evaluate impacts, and support successful project execution.
  • Apply Earned Value Management (EVM) principles to monitor program performance, analyze CPI/SPI trends, and generate earned value reports and S-curves.
  • Conduct cost and schedule variance analysis against approved baselines, identify root causes, and recommend corrective actions to improve project performance.
  • Prepare and deliver monthly progress reports, performance metrics, financial analyses, forecasts, and contract-required data submissions for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Support risk management, change control, and integrated cost/schedule analysis processes while ensuring compliance with governance standards, GPMO requirements, and SOX (Sarbanes Oxley) controls.
  • Partner with project managers, functional teams, customers, and executives to drive continuous improvement initiatives, strengthen stakeholder engagement, and mentor junior project controls personnel.

YOU MUST HAVE

  • 6+ years’ experience as a Program Scheduler

WE VALUE

  • Bachelor's degree in Business or Economics, Finance, Math, or related field
  • Serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in Primavera P6, Microsoft Project, and PMIS scheduling tools, with advanced knowledge of Earned Value Management (EVM) methodologies and performance metrics.
  • Analyze and manage financial and project data using ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, and Microsiga, leveraging advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Project, PowerPoint, Outlook, and other Office applications.
  • Interface effectively with external customers and internal stakeholders, influencing decision-making across organizational levels and communicating complex technical and financial information clearly to diverse audiences.
  • Hold project management credentials such as PMP or PMI-SP and demonstrate strong cross-cultural communication skills through bi/multilingual capabilities and collaborative stakeholder engagement.

BENEFITS OF WORKING FOR HONEYWELL

In addition to a competitive salary, leading-edge work, and developing solutions side-by-side with dedicated experts in their fields, Honeywell employees are eligible for a comprehensive benefits package. This package includes employer subsidized Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance; Short-Term and Long-Term Disability; 401(k) match, Flexible Spending Accounts, Health Savings Accounts, EAP, and Educational Assistance; Parental Leave, Paid Time Off (for vacation, personal business, sick time, and parental leave), and 12 Paid Holidays. Learn more

The application period for the job is estimated to be 40 days from the job posting date; however, this may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. Posted Date: 11/3/2026.

ABOUT HONEYWELL TECHNOLOGIES

Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial, and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions, and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy. title: Senior Software Integration Engineer (Payloads & Integrations)
description:
Who We Are


At Firestorm, we are building the future of expeditionary defense manufacturing and autonomous systems. Modern conflict has exposed a fundamental problem: the systems needed most by operators are often too expensive, too slow to produce, and too difficult to sustain at scale. Firestorm exists to change that.

We develop mission-adaptable aerial systems and deployable manufacturing infrastructure designed to put capability directly into the hands of the warfighter. From modular unmanned aircraft to xCell — our deployable microfactory — our goal is to make defense systems rapidly deployable, adaptable, and producible at the point of need.

We are looking for builders, operators, and problem-solvers who want to work on meaningful technology with real-world impact.

About the Role


Firestorm is seeking a Senior Software Integration Engineer to join our Payloads & Integrations team. This role exists to accelerate the integration of new mission payloads and capabilities into Firestorm's autonomous systems.

You will operate at the intersection of software, hardware, and mission systems – developing the interfaces, tooling, and integrations required to rapidly deploy new payload capabilities. This includes integrating cameras, radios, sensors, and other mission equipment through SDKs, APIs, and custom software workflows. You will work closely with Firestorm's core software organization, which owns the mainline software stack. Your role will be to rapidly develop and validate payload integrations through an out-of-cycle (branched) development process, then collaborate with the broader software organization to upstream production-ready capabilities into future releases.

This is a hands-on IC engineering role for someone who enjoys moving quickly across software layers, debugging complex systems, and solving ambiguous integration problems.

What You'll Do


  • Build and maintain software interfaces between payload hardware, mission applications, and autonomy systems
  • Integrate SDKs and APIs for cameras, gimbals, radios, sensors, and other mission equipment
  • Develop tools and applications supporting payload configuration, monitoring, and control
  • Customize or extend mission applications such as QGroundControl, TAK-based applications, and related operator interfaces
  • Debug complex systems spanning Linux, networking, hardware interfaces, and distributed software components
  • Build Docker-based deployment workflows for fielded software capabilities
  • Work within a side-branch development process and collaborate with the core software team to make upstream production-ready changes
  • Participate in field testing, demonstrations, and integration activities

Required Qualifications


  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • U.S. Citizenship required due to ITAR regulations.
  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience.
  • Strong programming ability in one or more modern languages (C++, Python, Rust, Go, Java, TypeScript, or similar).
  • Demonstrated history of holding yourself and your teammates to a high standard, even when it creates discomfort.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals with experience across multiple layers of the stack
  • Strong Linux experience including command-line workflows, debugging, and system administration tasks
  • Experience with networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, UDP, routing, and network troubleshooting
  • Experience integrating software with external systems through APIs, SDKs, or communication protocols
  • Ability to quickly understand and modify large existing codebases
  • Experience developing reliable production software in fast-moving environments
  • Experience with Git including branching and upstream contributions

Preferred Qualifications


  • Background that includes both startup and scale-stage product engineering.
  • Experience with autonomous systems, UAVs, robotics, or defense technology
  • Experience with QGroundControl, MAVLink, PX4, ArduPilot, or similar platforms
  • Experience with TAK ecosystems or tactical mission applications
  • Experience integrating cameras, gimbals, radios, or other payload hardware
  • Experience with embedded systems or edge computing environments
  • Experience with Docker and containerized deployments
  • Experience contributing changes back into shared production software repositories
  • Experience supporting field deployments and troubleshooting operational systems

Work Environment


Based at our Headquarters in San Diego, CA. We welcome candidates who are local or open to relocating; relocation assistance is available and may be included in the offer package where appropriate

This role includes occasional domestic travel (approximately 10%) for field testing, payload integration, demonstrations, and operational support.

Compensation


US Salary Range: $140,000 - $170,000 USD

The posted salary range reflects an estimate based on a variety of compensation factors, including but not limited to relevant experience, education, certifications, specialized skills, geographic location, and business needs. Actual compensation may vary, and this range is subject to change as our compensation structure or market conditions evolve.

Benefits & Perks

Our culture fosters collaboration, respect, and trust, empowering passionate people to do their best work. We offer a competitive salary, comprehensive benefits, and opportunities for career growth. In addition to an opportunity to take part in an innovative, collaborative and fast-growing business with a highly motivated and skilled team, we also take pride in taking care of our employees. Here are just a few ways that we show our appreciation:

  • We offer comprehensive medical, dental, and visions plans
  • 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan to invest in your long-term retirement goals
  • Equity grants for new hires
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Extremely generous company holiday calendar, including a holiday hiatus in November, & December
  • Generous Parental Leave
  • Lifestyle Spending Account
  • FSA
  • DCFSA
  • HSA
  • Hospital Indemnity insurance
  • Critical Illness insurance
  • Accident insurance
  • Basic Life/AD&D, short-term and long-term disability insurance, 100% covered by Firestorm. Plus, the option to purchase additional life insurance for you and your family
  • Mental Health Resources: We provide free mental health resources 24/7 including therapy and more. Additional work-life services, such as free legal and financial support, are available to you as well

Export Control Compliance

To conform to U.S. government export control regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and Export Administration Regulations (EAR), you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or otherwise eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State or U.S. Department of Commerce.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Firestorm is an equal opportunity employer, committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace, and upholding equitable hiring practices. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic under federal, state, or local law, including those with a criminal history, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the CA Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance. We actively encourage members of recognized minorities, women, Veterans, and those with disabilities to apply, and we work to create a welcoming and supportive environment for all applicants throughout the interview process.
Firestorm is committed to fostering an inclusive and accessible work environment. If you require accommodations or assistance during the application process, please don’t hesitate to reach out to us at careers@launchfirestorm.com so we can provide the support you need.
