title: Process & Procedures Lead
description:
Butcher Power Products is a Panelmatic company. This role will work directly for Panelmatic at our Houston, TX location.

Process & Procedures Lead

About the Role
We are seeking an experienced Process & Procedures Lead to design, implement, and continuously improve the Project Management Office (PMO) operating framework across the enterprise.
This role is responsible for building the PMO foundation from the ground up, including the development and deployment of project management processes, procedures, governance standards, KPIs, templates, reporting frameworks, stage-gate requirements, quality management systems (QMS), financial reporting, portfolio performance management, and PMO best practices.
The Process & Procedures Lead will define how projects are executed across the organization while establishing standardized ways of working that drive consistency, accountability, visibility, predictable execution, and project delivery excellence.
Working closely with Project Managers, Operations, Engineering, Finance, Quality, IT, Supply Chain, and executive leadership, this individual will create scalable systems and standards that can be deployed across all projects, programs, portfolios, and company locations.
The role will establish and govern the complete project management lifecycle, including project intake, kickoff, planning, execution, monitoring and control, reporting, stage-gate governance, financial management, project closeout, lessons learned, and continuous improvement processes.
This position is ideal for a leader who thrives on building structure from scratch, implementing industry best practices, and driving PMO maturity across a growing organization.

The Opportunity
As the organization continues to expand its project portfolio and operational footprint, this role will serve as the architect of the PMO operating model.
The Process & Procedures Lead will establish the standards, methodologies, governance structures, tools, reporting systems, training programs, and performance metrics that will govern project execution across the enterprise.
The successful candidate will leverage PMI standards, industry best practices, and lessons learned from high-performing PMOs to create a scalable framework that supports multiple locations, project types, and business units.
This role will play a critical part in transforming the PMO into a best-in-class organization through the implementation of standardized practices, disciplined governance, measurable performance metrics, financial transparency, and continuous improvement initiatives.

What You'll Do
PMO Methodology & Governance
  • Build and implement the PMO operating model from the ground up.
  • Develop and deploy enterprise-wide project management standards, methodologies, governance frameworks, and PMO ways of working.
  • Establish project lifecycle management standards from project intake through project closeout.
  • Define project governance structures, review boards, escalation paths, and approval processes.
  • Develop stage-gate methodologies, gate review requirements, and approval criteria.
  • Create PMO policies, procedures, governance manuals, and operating playbooks.
  • Lead PMO maturity assessments and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Ensure alignment with PMI standards and project management best practices.
Processes, Procedures & Standards
  • Develop and standardize project lifecycle processes from project intake through project closeout.
  • Establish project kickoff requirements, stakeholder alignment processes, and startup procedures.
  • Define project planning standards, including scope definition, schedule development, resource planning, risk management, budget management, and communications planning.
  • Develop standardized frameworks for:
    • Project Initiation
    • Project Kickoff
    • Project Planning
    • Scheduling & Project Controls
    • Risk Management
    • Opportunity Management
    • Change Management
    • Scope Management
    • Cost Management
    • Resource Management
    • Financial Forecasting
    • Customer Communication
    • Executive Reporting
    • Stage-Gate Reviews
    • Project Closeout
    • Lessons Learned
  • Standardize project execution, monitoring, control, and reporting processes across the organization.
  • Establish project health review processes, escalation procedures, and portfolio governance requirements.
  • Develop project closeout procedures, including customer acceptance, financial reconciliation, document archival, and transition to operations.
  • Create lessons learned processes and best-practice repositories to drive continuous improvement.
  • Ensure processes are scalable, repeatable, and consistently applied across all projects and locations.

KPI Development & Performance Measurement
  • Design and implement the enterprise PMO KPI framework.
  • Develop project, program, portfolio, and PMO performance metrics.
  • Establish measurements for:
    • On-Time Delivery
    • Schedule Performance Index (SPI)
    • Cost Performance Index (CPI)
    • Forecast Accuracy
    • Revenue Performance
    • Margin Performance
    • Resource Utilization
    • Customer Satisfaction
    • Risk Performance
    • Change Management Performance
    • Project Health
    • Portfolio Health
    • Stage-Gate Compliance
    • PMO Maturity
  • Develop executive dashboards, scorecards, and performance reports.
  • Analyze trends and recommend corrective actions and improvement initiatives.
  • Establish reporting standards and portfolio review cadences.

Templates, Tools & Documentation
  • Develop and maintain standardized PMO templates, including:
    • Project Intake Forms
    • Project Charters
    • Project Kickoff Presentations
    • Project Management Plans
    • Integrated Master Schedules
    • Stakeholder Registers
    • Communication Plans
    • Risk Registers
    • RAID Logs
    • Change Requests
    • Stage-Gate Deliverables
    • Executive Status Reports
    • Steering Committee Presentations
    • Project Dashboards
    • Resource Plans
    • Financial Tracking Templates
    • Project Health Assessment Templates
    • Customer Satisfaction Surveys
    • Project Closeout Reports
    • Lessons Learned Documents
    • Portfolio Review Templates
  • Establish document management, document control, and version control standards.
  • Ensure consistency across all project documentation and reporting.

PMO Quality Management System (QMS)
  • Develop and maintain the Project Management Quality Management System (QMS).
  • Establish PMO audit processes and compliance requirements.
  • Create procedures to ensure adherence to PMO standards and governance.
  • Implement project management audits, assessments, and compliance reviews.
  • Develop corrective action processes and continuous improvement programs.
  • Standardize quality requirements across all projects and locations.
  • Drive process compliance and governance maturity across the organization.

Financial Reporting & Project Controls
  • Develop standardized project financial reporting processes.
  • Partner with Finance to establish project and portfolio financial governance.
  • Implement reporting standards for:
    • Revenue Forecasting
    • Cost Management
    • Margin Tracking
    • Budget Performance
    • Resource Forecasting
    • Cash Flow Reporting
    • Earned Value Management
    • Portfolio Financial Performance
  • Develop executive financial dashboards and portfolio reporting.
  • Improve visibility into project financial performance and portfolio health.
  • Establish project controls standards and financial review processes.

Reporting, Analytics & Automation
  • Develop enterprise PMO dashboards and portfolio reporting solutions.
  • Establish reporting standards and reporting cadences.
  • Partner with IT to automate KPI reporting and project performance tracking.
  • Support ERP integration, dashboard development, and reporting standardization initiatives.
  • Leverage Power BI and reporting tools to improve decision-making and visibility.
  • Develop project analytics and portfolio management reporting capabilities.

Training & PMO Adoption
  • Develop PMO onboarding materials, training programs, playbooks, and user guides.
  • Conduct PMO workshops and process deployment sessions.
  • Train Project Managers and stakeholders on PMO methodologies, tools, and standards.
  • Drive organizational adoption of PMO governance and best practices.
  • Serve as the PMO subject matter expert for project governance and execution excellence.

What We're Looking For
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Project Management, Operations Management, Finance, Industrial Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • PMP Certification required.
  • 8-12 years of progressive experience in Project Management, PMO, Governance, Business Process Improvement, Program Management, Operational Excellence, or Project Controls.
  • Demonstrated experience managing projects involving protection and control systems, medium- and low-voltage switchgear, relay panels, motor control centers (MCCs), power distribution equipment, industrial control panels, integrated E-House/control house solutions, data center power systems, and other engineered electrical systems.
  • Demonstrated experience developing PMO frameworks, methodologies, governance models, and operating procedures from the ground up.
  • Experience implementing enterprise-wide project management standards across multiple projects, business units, and locations.
  • Strong knowledge of PMI methodologies, stage-gate governance, project controls, portfolio management, and PMO best practices.
  • Experience developing enterprise KPI frameworks, executive dashboards, scorecards, and performance measurement systems.
  • Experience implementing and managing Quality Management Systems (QMS) and governance programs.
  • Strong understanding of project financial reporting, forecasting, budgeting, margin management, and portfolio analytics.
  • Experience with ERP systems, Power BI, Microsoft Project, SharePoint, and project reporting platforms.
  • Strong analytical, process improvement, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, leadership, and stakeholder management abilities.
  • Experience within engineered-to-order manufacturing, industrial, electrical equipment, power distribution, utilities, renewable energy, EPC, data center, construction, infrastructure, or automation environments preferred.

Leadership Profile
The ideal candidate is a strategic thinker and builder who excels at creating structure, discipline, governance, and scalable systems within growing organizations.
They possess a passion for standardization, operational excellence, continuous improvement, and data-driven decision-making. They can effectively balance strategic planning with hands-on execution while driving enterprise-wide adoption across multiple stakeholders and locations.
The successful candidate is capable of transforming an evolving PMO into a mature, high-performing organization through the implementation of world-class processes, reporting frameworks, governance models, quality systems, financial controls, and best practices.
Most importantly, they are committed to creating a PMO that delivers predictable project outcomes, strong financial performance, measurable KPIs, effective governance, and consistent execution excellence across the enterprise.

Location & Travel
  • This position is based in Houston, Texas.
  • Supports PMO governance, process deployment, and standardization initiatives across all company locations.
  • Travel up to 20% may be required to support training, workshops, audits, process implementation, PMO deployments, and governance reviews across multiple sites.
  • Responsible for driving consistency, governance, reporting, and PMO best practices across the entire project portfolio and organization.

description:
As a Senior Data Program Management Specialist within Honeywell’s Commercial Data & Analytics function, you will be a pivotal leader in shaping and delivering data programs that improve commercial performance and enable smarter, faster decisions across the business. This role sits at the intersection of strategy, sales operations, analytics, and technology, translating complex commercial needs into scalable data solutions and measurable business outcomes.

You will partner closely with senior leaders across business groups to align priorities, drive execution, and ensure data products (dashboards, datasets, metrics, and analytical solutions) are trusted, adopted, and impactful.

You will report directly to our Senior Director of Data Program Management and work out of our Charlotte, NC location on a hybrid work schedule. Note: for the first 90 days, new hires must be prepared to work onsite 100% M-F.

In this role, you will elevate how Honeywell plans, measures, and optimizes commercial execution, helping teams improve sales effectiveness, sales excellence execution, incentive outcomes, channel performance, and resource allocation through world-class data program delivery.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end delivery of commercial data program - Own program scope, milestones, dependencies, risks, and delivery health across multiple workstreams.
  • Establish clear outcomes, success metrics, and value realization plans tied to commercial priorities.
  • Drive commercial analytics initiatives that support sales growth and efficiency.
  • Partner with Sales, Sales Excellence, on initiatives such as: Sales incentive plan analytics & performance measurement, sales headcount allocation and coverage modeling, territory planning support and productivity insights.
  • Translate business questions into data requirements, solutions, and actionable insights.

    standardized definitions, lineage, and documentation; data quality monitoring and issue remediation; scalable, reusable data assets and metric frameworks.
  • Program communication and change enablement - Manage stakeholder communications, release plans, training readiness, and adoption tracking.
  • Maintain high-quality documentation in knowledge repositories to sustain and scale solutions.

YOU MUST HAVE

  • 3+ years of experience in data program management, analytics delivery, commercial operations, or related roles
  • 3+ years of experience in Power BI (semantic models, dashboards, KPI scorecards) - Sales excellence concepts and execution enablement
  • 3+ years of experience in SQL (querying, validation, reconciliation) and Program delivery tools: JIRA, Confluence, Smartsheet (and/or similar)
  • 3+ years of experience leading complex programs in analytics, data, or commercial operations with consistent, on-time delivery across multiple stakeholders

WE VALUE

  • Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Data Management, Business Administration, or related field.

  • Comfortable engaging with senior leaders, presenting succinctly, and managing expectations with confidence

  • Strong organizational skills with attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Intellectual curiosity and continuous improvement orientation-always looking for ways to simplify, standardize, and scale

In addition to a competitive salary, leading-edge work, and developing solutions side-by-side with dedicated experts in their fields, Honeywell employees are eligible for a comprehensive benefits package. This package includes employer subsidized Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance; Short-Term and Long-Term Disability; 401(k) match, Flexible Spending Accounts, Health Savings Accounts, EAP, and Educational Assistance; Parental Leave, Paid Time Off (for vacation, personal business, sick time, and parental leave), and 12 Paid Holidays. Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial, and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions, and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. title: Data Scientist - Machine Learning - RealAdvisor
location: France; Slovakia; Estonia; Latvia; Slovenia; Czechia
description:
🧭 About RealAdvisor

RealAdvisor is one of the leading digital platforms in the European real estate ecosystem. Founded in Switzerland, we now support 7,000+ real estate agencies and attract 10+ million users per year across Europe.

We are scaling fast across multiple markets with a clear mission: help real estate professionals grow through data, transparency and smart technology. At RealAdvisor, we value ownership, autonomy and impact.

Role Overview

We are looking for a business‑oriented Data Scientist to join RealAdvisor. You will consolidate and analyze diverse data sources (product, marketing, transactional), build ML models and experiments to drive subscription growth, and translate insights into concrete product and marketing actions. This is a hands‑on, full‑stack role: you will query databases, run experiments, build models, and present clear data stories to stakeholders.

Requirements

Key responsibilities

    • Consolidate and aggregate data from product, marketing, CRM, and transactional systems into reliable datasets.
    • Perform product analytics to measure feature usage, user journeys, and retention drivers.
    • Design and run experiments (A/B tests, cohort analysis, population and variation control) to validate hypotheses and measure causal impact.
    • Build ML models for revenue optimization, churn prediction, segmentation, and subscription forecasting.
    • Analyze marketing performance to measure acquisition efficiency, LTV, and campaign ROI.
    • Translate analysis into action: propose product changes, growth experiments, and operational KPIs.
    • Report results using concise dashboards, reports, and data storytelling for non‑technical stakeholders.
    • Work cross‑functionally with product, marketing, engineering, and country managers to standardize metrics and training.
    • Maintain data quality: identify polluted data, propose remediation, and implement robust ETL checks.

Required skills and experience

  • 3+ years in data science, analytics.
  • Python and SQL skills for data manipulation, modeling, and production prototyping.
  • Experience consolidating diverse data sources and building reliable analytical pipelines.
  • Experiment design and causal inference methods.
  • Practical ML experience (classification, regression, segmentation) and model evaluation.
  • Product analytics tools experience.
  • Ability to build dashboards and present insights clearly (Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or similar).
  • Business mindset: translates technical results into measurable business outcomes.
  • Proactive: takes initiative, owns end‑to‑end delivery, and can work with limited supervision.

Nice to have

  • Experience with subscription businesses and monetization models.
  • Familiarity with marketing attribution and LTV modeling.
  • Frontend or backend dev experience to implement tracking or small UI changes.
  • Knowledge of data engineering tools (Airflow, dbt, Spark).
  • Experience working across international markets and multilingual datasets.

Benefits

Why Join Us

  • Fully remote.
  • Full-time freelance role.
  • Competitive monthly rate.

title: Advanced Cyber Security Architect/Engineer
description:
As an Advanced Cyber Security Architect/Engineer at the Honeywell Industrial Cybersecurity Centers of Excellent and Innovation, you will lead the research, development, and engineering of standardized OT cybersecurity solutions. In this hands-on role, you will perform technology validation, drive solution development, conduct rigorous testing, and act as the subject matter expert to transition innovative research into core cyber software-enabled service offerings. You will be responsible for fortifying industrial defenses against existing and emerging threats, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and fostering a culture of continuous technical improvement.


In this role, you will drive our cybersecurity initiatives by ensuring the safety, availability, and physical reliability of critical infrastructure and industrial control systems across businesses worldwide. You will play a pivotal role in formal, standardized OT offerings, driving technical excellence, and validating solutions that mitigate cyber-physical risks. Your work will directly protect process integrity and prevent operational disruptions, securing the vital systems that power the modern world.

Join the Honeywell Industrial Cyber COE & Innovation team, where cybersecurity meets innovation, and together, we'll build a safer, more secure future.

You will report directly to our Director Cyber Security, and you’ll work out of our Duluth, GA location on a Hybrid work schedule.

Key Responsibilities

  • Responsible for co-operating cyber-COE infrastructure ensuring systems are well-maintained and available, as business requires.
  • Perform Application and System administration tasks required to keep the Cyber COE infrastructure operational at industry standard level
  • Research solutions to challenging industrial cyber security problems
  • Develop and standardize cybersecurity services portfolio
  • Support system test and qualification activities through the development life cycle.
  • Plan, implement, manage, and monitor various cyber security technologies and proficiency with the following: Anti-Virus, Application/Device Control, EDR/XDR, Network IDS/IPS, Log/Packet Analysis, Vulnerability management, User activity monitoring, Cryptography, SIEM, etc.
  • Troubleshooting security problems; testing and identifying security vulnerabilities
  • Conduct security assessments on OT networks, systems, and applications.
  • Conduct authorized penetration testing, adversary emulation, and purple teaming exercises in OT production environments
  • Regularly engage with account managers, business development managers, solution architects, and customers to develop and deliver technical presentation on Honeywell industrial cyber security products and services.
  • Write / craft clear, understandable documentation that translates complicated technical processes to a target audience. Deliverables include technical publications; industry conference presentations; course development and delivery; and prototype tools and techniques.
  • Provide technical guidance and support on current Honeywell cybersecurity products and services
  • Liaison Develop sound and trusted relationships with internal customers by providing accurate and efficient technical/engineering support. Interact with the Global Cyber CoE and Innovation subject matter experts and assist in resolving technical issues during project lifecycle. with HON Corp IT to ensure compliance with security standards and policies.
  • Conduct advanced training courses in cyber operations such as; Next Generation Firewalls, Intrusion detection and investigation, industrial control network and system exploitation, Honeywell developed security solutions and other relevant topics

title: Clerk of Court 3 (41-3114) Kodiak
description:
Job Description



The Clerk of Court 3 (salary range 14) provides leadership, supervision, and technical support for all clerk’s office operations, ensuring efficient case management, accurate court records, and compliance with Alaska Court Rules, policies, and procedures. This position oversees staff performance, case flow, courtroom and jury operations, hearing schedules, and customer service while identifying and implementing operational improvements.

Additional responsibilities include overseeing daily court operations, including staff recruitment, hiring, training, performance evaluations, employee relations, and compliance with personnel policies and procedures. Assigns and prioritizes workloads, conducts staff meetings, and promotes employee development, morale, and effective communication. Manages court financial operations, ensuring proper cash-handling procedures and accurate collection and disbursement of fines, restitution, and other funds. Processes marriage licenses, maintains court documents and financial records, and serves as a liaison to the public, attorneys, judges, and community organizations by addressing concerns and supporting community outreach. Oversees court technology, facilities, equipment, and resources; collaborates with judges and court administrators; and provides operational and backup support to other Third District courts, including reporting, special projects, and other duties as assigned.


IMPORTANT: Please attach a letter of interest in employment with the Alaska Court System. Failure to submit a letter may disqualify you from consideration for an interview.

* Employees transferring from another State of Alaska agency or applicants with prior legal work experience or education in the legal field may receive consideration for advance step placement. *


The Work Hours

Full-time court employees are currently scheduled to work 37.5 hours per week. The work hours for these positions are Monday - Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. with a one-hour lunch break.



Exceptional Benefits

We offer a competitive benefits package that includes 12 paid holidays, medical, dental, and optional vision coverage, and employer-paid life insurance. Employees are enrolled in the Public Employees Retirement System (PERS) and the Alaska Supplemental Annuity Plan (SBS), with access to the Alaska Deferred Compensation Plan. Personal leave is accrued for vacation, illness, or personal needs.

Enjoy peace of mind and long-term security while serving your community.

See for additional information.






For more information on the Alaska Court System, please visit:


For information about what state courts do, please watch the following short video:

VIDEO: The who, what, when, where and how of state courts


The Alaska Court System is an EEO employer and proudly promotes diversity.


Minimum Qualifications

A high school diploma or General Educational Development (GED) certificate AND two years of advanced general clerical or legal clerical work experience AND the ability to keyboard at least 40 words per minute (net). The required work experience is met by service such as a Court Case Manager 1, Court Case Manager 2, Court Supervisor, Clerk of Court, Chambers Judicial Assistant, or Chief Deputy Clerk with the Alaska Court System or similar work experience with another employer.

OR

A bachelor’s degree from an accredited college in any field AND one year of advanced general clerical or legal clerical work experience AND the ability to keyboard at least 40 words per minute (net). The required work experience is met by service such as a Court Case Manager 1, Court Case Manager 2, Court Supervisor, Clerk of Court, Chambers Judicial Assistant, or Chief Deputy Clerk with the Alaska Court System or similar work experience with another employer.

OR

A bachelor’s degree from an accredited college in business administration, public administration, criminal justice, or a closely related field AND the ability to keyboard at least 40 words per minute (net).

Additional Required Information

This applies to your application submission.

Documents to be Attached to the Application (REQUIRED):

  • A letter of interest, completed per the instructions below.
  • Keyboarding certification dated within one year showing a keyboarding speed of at least 40 words per minute (net).
  • Post-secondary transcripts, if using education to meet minimum qualifications.
  • Copies of your most recent (2) performance evaluations, if available.
  • A list of three (3) professional references who have had supervisory authority over you, including your most recent supervisor, along with their daytime contact phone numbers and email addresses.


LETTER OF INTEREST
Please attach this to your application before submitting it online or, if unable to attach to your application email it to recruitment@akcourts.gov.

Your letter should:
1) Be professionally written and include proper format, grammar, spelling and punctuation.
2) Explain how you meet the minimum qualifications of the position.
3) Explain why you are the best candidate for the position.

Your letter will be used to help determine which applicants will advance to the interview phase of the recruitment and selection process. If you do not attach a professional letter of interest, you may not move on to the interview phase.

LEGAL EMPLOYMENT
The State’s online recruitment system, Workplace Alaska, requires applicants to certify that they have a legal right to accept employment in the United States. It is the responsibility of the employee to maintain the appropriate documentation to accept or continue legal employment. The Alaska Court System does not sponsor visas.

WORK EXPERIENCE
If using work experience not already documented in your application, provide the employer’s name, your job title, dates of employment and whether full or part-time. Applications will be reviewed to determine if the responses are supported and Minimum Qualifications are clearly met. If they are not, the applicant will not advance to the interview and selection phase of the recruitment.

EDUCATION
If post-secondary education is required to meet the Minimum Qualifications, you must fill in the Education and Training section of the application. If you have not obtained a degree, please indicate the number of credit hours earned in the Degree Obtained field. Copies of transcripts are required to verify educational credentials used to meet or support the minimum qualifications for the position and are required with each application.

SPECIAL INSTRUCTIONS FOR FOREIGN EDUCATION
Education completed in foreign colleges or universities may be used to meet the minimum qualifications listed above. If utilizing this education, you must show that the education credentials have been submitted to a private organization that specializes in the interpretation of foreign educational credentials and that such education has been deemed to be at least equivalent to that gained in conventional U.S. education programs; or an accredited U.S. post-secondary institution reports the other institution as one whose transcript is given full value, or full value is given in subject areas applicable to the curricula at the post-secondary institution. It is your responsibility to provide such evidence when applying.

SELECTION PROCEDURE
Applicants will be required to meet the Minimum Qualifications as outlined above. Unfortunately, we cannot always interview all applicants. If your application is considered "not qualified," you will be sent a notice within two weeks after the closing date for this recruitment. If you believe your application was improperly disqualified, you may appeal this decision to the Human Resources Director at 820 West 4th Avenue, Anchorage, AK 99501-2005 within five workdays from the date the notice is mailed to you. Qualified applications will be forwarded to the hiring supervisor.

MULTIPLE VACANCIES NOTICE
This recruitment may be used for more than one (1) vacancy. The applicant pool acquired during this recruitment may be used for future vacancies for up to sixty (60) days after this recruitment closes. Interested applicants are encouraged to apply to each recruitment notice to ensure consideration for all vacancies.

NEPOTISM REVIEW
To avoid a conflict of interest and the appearance of impropriety, applicants who have a spouse, close relative, and/or regular member of their household employed by the Alaska Court System may not be considered for employment without the approval of the Administrative Director.

BACKGROUND CHECK
A background check will be conducted prior to an employment offer being made. Applicants who have prior convictions that have been set aside under the terms of a suspended imposition of sentence (SIS) may answer "no" to these questions. If you are not sure if your situation requires disclosure, please contact the Human Resources Department at (907) 264-8242. The Court System reserves the right to confirm all background information.

Contact Information

E-Mail: recruitment@akcourts.gov

Mailing Address: 820 West 4th Avenue, Anchorage, AK 99501

Phone Number: (907) 264-8242

title: Consultant Retail Advanced Analytics
description:
Location: Hershey, PA (Remote)

Why Hershey:

At The Hershey Company, our culture is rooted in purpose and inspired by Milton Hershey’s enduring vision that business should create opportunity for others. Through our commitment to corporate philanthropy, we create positive impact by supporting communities, helping children thrive, and operating as a business for good. This includes our deep and long standing partnership with Milton Hershey School, where we invest in education, workforce readiness, and hands on engagement to help students succeed beyond the classroom. Supported by strategic grantmaking, product donations, cross brand collaboration, and strong employee volunteerism, Hershey offers a place to work where making a difference—locally and globally—is part of how we do business every day.

About The Hershey Company

The Hershey Company is an industry-leading snacks company known for making more moments of goodness through its iconic brands. With a strong portfolio across chocolate, confectionery, and salty snacks, Hershey delights consumers every day. Our beloved brands include Hershey’s, Reese’s, KitKat®, Dots Pretzels, Lesser Evil, Jolly Rancher, Twizzlers, Ice Breakers, and more.

At Hershey, we are committed to making a meaningful difference in the communities where we live, work, and do business. This commitment originated with our founder, Milton Hershey, and continues to shape who we are today.

Guided by our employee value proposition, Lead Today. Create Tomorrow, we empower our people to drive impact now while shaping what comes next. Our One Hershey mindset brings teams together across functions, geographies, and businesses, enabling us to operate with speed, collaboration, and shared purpose.

The Hershey Company is proud to be recognized as a top employer in the United States, reflecting our commitment to our people, culture, and purpose.

How will you fit in the big picture?

The Consultant, Retail Advanced Analytics is responsible for delivering recurring reporting, scorecards, and analytics that measure U.S. retail field sales performance. This role partners with Retail Leadership, Field Sales, and cross-functional teams to provide standardized visibility into execution, sales trends, compliance, productivity, and performance metrics.

The position independently manages recurring analytics workstreams, consolidates data from multiple sources, develops reporting and dashboards, and translates findings into actionable insights that support business decision-making and field sales effectiveness.

What will you do?

Retail Analytics & Reporting

  • Build and deliver recurring Territory Sales Lead (TSL) and Territory Sales Associate (TSA) scorecards measuring field sales performance, execution, compliance, and POS results.
  • Produce weekly, monthly, and ad hoc reporting for Retail Leadership and key customer teams.
  • Generate payroll, retail hours, productivity, and performance reporting.
  • Maintain reporting accuracy, consistency, and data integrity across deliverables.

Data Analysis & Insights

  • Consolidate and analyze data from Salesforce, Circana, Power BI, VOLT/Scintilla, and customer-provided sources.
  • Translate complex data into actionable insights and business recommendations.
  • Identify performance trends, opportunities, and areas requiring attention.
  • Support leadership decision-making through clear reporting and analysis.

Dashboard & Reporting Development

  • Support development and enhancement of dashboards and analytics tools.
  • Align reporting definitions, KPIs, and data sources across stakeholders.
  • Develop documentation and standardized reporting processes.
  • Improve reporting efficiency and usability for business partners.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Retail Leadership, Field Sales, GCC/Accenture, and customer teams.
  • Support Region Reviews, Talent Development reporting, and field sales analytics initiatives.
  • Provide analytical support for retail execution, performance management, and business planning.
  • Communicate findings and recommendations to stakeholders across the organization.

Minimum Education & Requirements

Experience

  • 3+ years of experience in Sales Analytics, Retail Analytics, Business Intelligence, Reporting, CPG Analytics, or a related field.
  • Experience working with retail execution data, field sales reporting, or syndicated POS data preferred.
  • Experience developing recurring scorecards, dashboards, and performance reporting.

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Analytics, Finance, Statistics, Economics, Data Analytics, or a related field preferred.

Benefits and Perks

At Hershey, we offer competitive pay and a comprehensive total rewards package designed to support your wellbeing, financial security, and life outside of work.

  • Health & Wellbeing: Medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus wellness programs that support your physical and mental health
  • Financial Security: Competitive pay, annual incentive opportunities, and a 401(k) with company match
  • Time Off & Flexibility: Paid time off, company holidays, and flexible ways of working where applicable
  • Growth & Development: Career development programs, learning opportunities, and internal mobility

Benefits may vary based on role, location, and eligibility.

The anticipated base salary range for this role is $87,840 to $109,800 per year. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of job‑related factors, including, but not limited to, experience, skill set, education, and training. Position Summary...

To provide customer service by completing assigned tasks relating to receiving and the flow of merchandise through to the sales floor. 1. Preparing the sales floor for store opening

5. Pulling pallets of merchandise to and from the sales floor for overnight processing
6. Assisting in stocking the sales floor as assigned and providing customer service if necessary
7. Label the sales floor for store opening
8. Contributes to a safe, clean and hazard free work environment through adherence to Company policy and procedures, including the completion of safety sweep logs and ensuring displays and fixtures are secure
